```{ojs}
// Q2 — summary table
hz_q2TableView = {
  const state = hz_q2DisplayState ?? {}
  const rows = Array.isArray(state.displayRows) ? state.displayRows : []
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">No data.</div>`

  const showPct = !!hz_q2_relative
  const showDiff = !!hz_q2_difference

  const fmtAbsFull = (v) => hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })
  const fmtPct = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    return `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })}%`
  }

  const fmtPP = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })} pp`
  }

  const fmtSignedAbs = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })}`
  }

  const tableData = rows.map((r) => ({
    "Crop": r.crop,
    "Hazard": r.hazard,
    "Left (abs)": Number(r?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Right (abs)": Number(r?.total2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (abs)": Number(r?.diff ?? 0),
    "Left (%)": Number(r?.perc1 ?? 0),
    "Right (%)": Number(r?.perc2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (pp)": Number(r?.perc_diff ?? 0)
  }))

  const columns = showDiff
    ? (showPct
        ? ["Crop", "Hazard", "Δ (pp)"]
        : ["Crop", "Hazard", "Δ (abs)"])
    : (showPct
        ? ["Crop", "Hazard", "Left (%)", "Right (%)"]
        : ["Crop", "Hazard", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)"])

  return hz_atlasTable(tableData, {
    columns,
    format: {
      "Left (abs)": fmtAbsFull,
      "Right (abs)": fmtAbsFull,
      "Δ (abs)": fmtSignedAbs,
      "Left (%)": fmtPct,
      "Right (%)": fmtPct,
      "Δ (pp)": fmtPP
    },
    rows: tableData.length,
    height: null,
    width: {
      "Crop": 220,
      "Hazard": 180,
      "Left (abs)": 140,
      "Right (abs)": 140,
      "Δ (abs)": 140,
      "Left (%)": 120,
      "Right (%)": 120,
      "Δ (pp)": 120
    }
  })
}

hz_q2SummaryExport = {
  const state = hz_q2DisplayState ?? {}
  const rows = Array.isArray(state.displayRows) ? state.displayRows : []
  if (!rows.length) return { filename: "most_exposed_crops", data: [] }

  const showPct = !!hz_q2_relative
  const showDiff = !!hz_q2_difference

  const tableData = rows.map((r) => ({
    "Crop": r.crop,
    "Hazard": r.hazard,
    "Left (abs)": Number(r?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Right (abs)": Number(r?.total2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (abs)": Number(r?.diff ?? 0),
    "Left (%)": Number(r?.perc1 ?? 0),
    "Right (%)": Number(r?.perc2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (pp)": Number(r?.perc_diff ?? 0)
  }))

  const columns = showDiff
    ? (showPct
        ? ["Crop", "Hazard", "Δ (pp)"]
        : ["Crop", "Hazard", "Δ (abs)"])
    : (showPct
        ? ["Crop", "Hazard", "Left (%)", "Right (%)"]
        : ["Crop", "Hazard", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)"])

  return {
    filename: "most_exposed_crops",
    data: tableData.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(columns.map((col) => [col, row[col]])))
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Q2 — Dynamic Insights
hz_q2InsightView = {
  const _langTick = masterLanguage
  const ok = !!hz_q2Meta?.ok
  if (!ok) {
    const err = hz_q2Meta?.error ?? "Missing required inputs."
    return html`<div class="hz-muted">${hz_tpl("sections.q2.insight.unavailable", { err })}</div>`
  }

  const denomMap = hz_q2DenomMap ?? new Map()
  const rowsL = Array.isArray(hz_q2DataL) ? hz_q2DataL : []
  const rowsR = Array.isArray(hz_q2DataR) ? hz_q2DataR : []

  const safe = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0
  }

  const prettyHaz = (h) => {
    const raw = String(h ?? "").trim()
    if (!raw) return "—"
    const h0 = raw.replace(/\s*\(.*?\)\s*/g, "").trim()
    if (!h0) return "—"
    const low = h0.toLowerCase()
    if (low === "no hazard") return hz_t("general.hazards.noHazard")
    if (low === "any") return hz_t("general.hazards.anyHazard")

    const cap = (s) => {
      const t = String(s ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!t) return ""
      if (t === "dry") return hz_t("general.hazards.dry")
      if (t === "heat") return hz_t("general.hazards.heat")
      if (t === "wet") return hz_t("general.hazards.wet")
      return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1)
    }

    return h0.split("+").map(cap).join("+")
  }

  const anyMap = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of (rows ?? [])) {
      if (String(r?.hazard ?? "") !== "any") continue
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      m.set(crop, safe(r?.total ?? 0))
    }
    return m
  }

  const pickTopHaz = (rows, crop, pred) => {
    let bestH = null
    let bestV = -Infinity
    for (const r of (rows ?? [])) {
      if (r?.crop !== crop) continue
      const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      if (!pred(h)) continue
      const v = safe(r?.total ?? 0)
      if (v > bestV) {
        bestV = v
        bestH = h
      }
    }
    return { hazard: bestH, value: (bestV === -Infinity ? 0 : bestV) }
  }

  const calcScenarioTable = (rows, label) => {
    const any = anyMap(rows)
    const crops = Array.from(new Set([...any.keys(), ...Array.from(denomMap.keys())]))

    const data = crops.map((crop) => {
      const denom = safe(denomMap.get(crop) || 0)
      const unit = safe(any.get(crop) || 0)
      const pct = denom > 0 ? (100 * unit / denom) : null

      const topAlone = pickTopHaz(rows, crop, (h) => {
        if (!h) return false
        if (h === "any" || h === "no hazard") return false
        return !h.includes("+")
      })

      const topComp = pickTopHaz(rows, crop, (h) => {
        if (!h) return false
        if (h === "any" || h === "no hazard") return false
        return h.includes("+")
      })

      const pctAlone = denom > 0 ? (100 * safe(topAlone.value) / denom) : null
      const pctComp = denom > 0 ? (100 * safe(topComp.value) / denom) : null

      const pctStr = (x) => (x == null ? "—" : `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 1, compact: false })}%`)
      const topAloneStr = topAlone.hazard ? `${prettyHaz(topAlone.hazard)} ${pctStr(pctAlone)}` : "—"
      const topCompStr = topComp.hazard ? `${prettyHaz(topComp.hazard)} ${pctStr(pctComp)}` : "—"

      return { crop, unit, pct: (pct ?? 0), topAloneStr, topCompStr }
    })

    data.sort((a, b) => (b.unit - a.unit))
    const top = data.slice(0, 5)

    const table = top.map((d) => ({
      [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity")]: d.crop,
      [absColLabel]: d.unit,
      [pctColLabel]: d.pct,
      [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topAlone")]: d.topAloneStr,
      [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topCompound")]: d.topCompStr
    }))

    return { label, table }
  }

  const s1 = hz_s1?.label ?? "Left"
  const s2 = hz_s2?.label ?? "Right"
  const sev = hz_severityLabel ?? "selected"
  const nSel = (hz_selectedCommoditiesForReq ?? []).length
  const selTxt = nSel ? `${nSel}` : hz_t("sections.q2.insight.your")

  const absColLabel = (() => {
    const base = String(hz_varLabelAbs ?? hz_varLabel ?? "Exposure").trim()
    return base || "Exposure"
  })()
  const pctMeasureLabel = (() => {
    const base = String(hz_varLabel ?? hz_formatVarShort(hz_varShort) ?? "measure").trim()
    return base || "measure"
  })()
  const pctColLabel = `% exposed (${pctMeasureLabel})`
  const deltaAbsColLabel = `Δ ${absColLabel}`
  const deltaPctColLabel = `Δ % exposed (pp)`

  const left = calcScenarioTable(rowsL, s1)
  const right = calcScenarioTable(rowsR, s2)

  const calcDiffTable = () => {
    const anyL = anyMap(rowsL)
    const anyR = anyMap(rowsR)
    const crops = Array.from(new Set([...anyL.keys(), ...anyR.keys(), ...Array.from(denomMap.keys())]))

    const byKey = (crop, h) => `${crop}||${h}`
    const mapL = new Map((rowsL ?? []).map((r) => [byKey(r?.crop ?? "", String(r?.hazard ?? "")), safe(r?.total ?? 0)]))
    const mapR = new Map((rowsR ?? []).map((r) => [byKey(r?.crop ?? "", String(r?.hazard ?? "")), safe(r?.total ?? 0)]))

    const diffRows = crops.map((crop) => {
      const denom = safe(denomMap.get(crop) || 0)
      const u1 = safe(anyL.get(crop) || 0)
      const u2 = safe(anyR.get(crop) || 0)
      const dU = u2 - u1
      const p1 = denom > 0 ? (100 * u1 / denom) : 0
      const p2 = denom > 0 ? (100 * u2 / denom) : 0
      const dP = p2 - p1

      const allHaz = new Set()
      for (const r of (rowsL ?? [])) if (r?.crop === crop) allHaz.add(String(r?.hazard ?? ""))
      for (const r of (rowsR ?? [])) if (r?.crop === crop) allHaz.add(String(r?.hazard ?? ""))

      const bestDelta = (pred) => {
        let bestH = null
        let bestAbs = -Infinity
        let bestDU = 0

        for (const h of allHaz) {
          if (!pred(h)) continue
          if (h === "any" || h === "no hazard") continue
          const v1 = safe(mapL.get(byKey(crop, h)) || 0)
          const v2 = safe(mapR.get(byKey(crop, h)) || 0)
          const du = v2 - v1
          const abs = Math.abs(du)
          if (abs > bestAbs) {
            bestAbs = abs
            bestH = h
            bestDU = du
          }
        }

        const dpp = denom > 0 ? (100 * bestDU / denom) : 0
        return { hazard: bestH, dpp }
      }

      const alone = bestDelta((h) => !String(h).includes("+"))
      const comp = bestDelta((h) => String(h).includes("+"))

      const fmtPP = (x) => {
        const v = Number(x)
        if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return "—"
        const sign = v > 0 ? "+" : ""
        return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 1, compact: false })} pp`
      }

      const topAlone = alone.hazard ? `${prettyHaz(alone.hazard)} ${fmtPP(alone.dpp)}` : "—"
      const topComp = comp.hazard ? `${prettyHaz(comp.hazard)} ${fmtPP(comp.dpp)}` : "—"

      return { crop, dU, dP, topAlone, topComp }
    })

    diffRows.sort((a, b) => (Math.abs(b.dU) - Math.abs(a.dU)))
    const top = diffRows.slice(0, 5)

    return top.map((d) => ({
      [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity")]: d.crop,
      [deltaAbsColLabel]: d.dU,
      [deltaPctColLabel]: d.dP,
      [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topDeltaAlone")]: d.topAlone,
      [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topDeltaCompound")]: d.topComp
    }))
  }

  const diffTable = calcDiffTable()

  const fmtAbs = (v) => hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })
  const fmtPct = (v) => `${hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 1, compact: false })}%`
  const fmtAbsSigned = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })}`
  }
  const fmtPP = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 1, compact: false })} pp`
  }

  return html`<div>
    ${md`${[
      `**${hz_t("sections.q2.insight.heading")}**`,
      "",
      hz_tpl("sections.q2.insight.intro", { selTxt, sev })
    ].join("\n\n")}`}

    <div class="hz-insightSubhead">${left.label}</div>
    ${hz_atlasTable(left.table, {
      columns: [
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity"),
        absColLabel,
        pctColLabel,
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topAlone"),
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topCompound")
      ],
      rows: left.table.length,
      height: null,
      format: {
        [absColLabel]: fmtAbs,
        [pctColLabel]: fmtPct
      },
      width: {
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity")]: 180,
        [absColLabel]: 220,
        [pctColLabel]: 180,
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topAlone")]: 220,
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topCompound")]: 280
      }
    })}

    <div class="hz-insightSubhead" style="margin-top:0.6rem">${right.label}</div>
    ${hz_atlasTable(right.table, {
      columns: [
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity"),
        absColLabel,
        pctColLabel,
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topAlone"),
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topCompound")
      ],
      rows: right.table.length,
      height: null,
      format: {
        [absColLabel]: fmtAbs,
        [pctColLabel]: fmtPct
      },
      width: {
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity")]: 180,
        [absColLabel]: 220,
        [pctColLabel]: 180,
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topAlone")]: 220,
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topCompound")]: 280
      }
    })}

    ${md`${hz_tpl("sections.q2.insight.change", { sev, s1, s2 })}`}

    ${hz_atlasTable(diffTable, {
      columns: [
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity"),
        deltaAbsColLabel,
        deltaPctColLabel,
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topDeltaAlone"),
        hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topDeltaCompound")
      ],
      rows: diffTable.length,
      height: null,
      format: {
        [deltaAbsColLabel]: fmtAbsSigned,
        [deltaPctColLabel]: fmtPP
      },
      width: {
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.commodity")]: 180,
        [deltaAbsColLabel]: 220,
        [deltaPctColLabel]: 180,
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topDeltaAlone")]: 220,
        [hz_t("sections.q2.insight.columns.topDeltaCompound")]: 300
      }
    })}

    ${hz_renderSummaryDownloadButton(hz_q2SummaryExport, "most_exposed_crops")}
  </div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// ============================================================
// Q3 — hazard by crop
hz_q3RespL = ({
  ok: !!hz_q2Resp?.ok,
  cached: !!hz_q2Resp?.cached,
  t_ms: Number(hz_q2Resp?.t_ms || 0),
  error: hz_q2Resp?.error || null,
  data: hz_q2Resp?.left ?? []
})

hz_q3RespR = ({
  ok: !!hz_q2Resp?.ok,
  cached: !!hz_q2Resp?.cached,
  t_ms: Number(hz_q2Resp?.t_ms || 0),
  error: hz_q2Resp?.error || null,
  data: hz_q2Resp?.right ?? []
})

hz_q3DataL = hz_q3RespL?.data ?? []
hz_q3DataR = hz_q3RespR?.data ?? []

hz_q3Meta = ({
  ok: !!hz_q2Meta?.ok,
  cached: !!hz_q2Meta?.cached,
  t_ms: Number(hz_q2Meta?.t_ms || 0),
  error: hz_q2Meta?.error || null
})

hz_q3Chart = {
  const L = hz_q3DataL ?? []
  const R = hz_q3DataR ?? []
  if (!L.length && !R.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">No data.</div>`

  const subtitle = `${hz_geoLabel} • ${hz_commodityLabel} • Left: ${hz_s1.label} • Right: ${hz_s2.label}`
  const fmtAbs = (x) => hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })

  // Top crops by combined exposure (Left + Right)
  const cropTotals = new Map()
  const bump = (crop, v) => cropTotals.set(crop, (cropTotals.get(crop) || 0) + Number(v || 0))
  for (const d of R) bump(d.crop, d.total)
  for (const d of L) bump(d.crop, d.total)

  const maxCrops = Math.min(10, Number(hz_topN || 10))
  const crops = Array.from(cropTotals.entries())
    .sort((a,b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, maxCrops)
    .map(([c]) => c)

  const hazards = Array.from(new Set([...L.map(d => d.hazard), ...R.map(d => d.hazard)])).sort()

  const filter = (data) =>
    data
      .filter(d => crops.includes(d.crop) && hazards.includes(d.hazard))
      .map(d => ({ crop: d.crop, hazard: d.hazard, total: Number(d.total || 0) }))

  // Shared categorical color scale (keeps left/right colors aligned)
  const color = hz_hazardColorConfig(hazards, false)
  const legend = Plot.legend({ color: hz_hazardColorConfig(hazards, true), columns: 3 })

  const plotStack = (data, title) => html`
    <div class="hz-mini hz-mini--stack">
      <div class="hz-mini__title">${title}</div>
      ${Plot.plot({
        height: Math.max(320, crops.length * 26, Number(hz_chartHeight ?? 520)),
        marginLeft: 160,
        marginRight: 18,
        marginTop: 10,
        marginBottom: 28,
        x: { label: (hz_varLabelAbs ?? "Exposure"), grid: true, tickFormat: fmtAbs },
        y: { domain: crops, label: null },
        color,
          marks: [
          Plot.barX(filter(data), Plot.stackX({
            x: "total",
            y: "crop",
            fill: "hazard",
            tip: {
              format: {
                crop: true,
                hazard: true,
                total: fmtAbs
              }
            }
          })),
          Plot.ruleX([0])
        ]
      })}
    </div>
  `

  return html`
    <div class="hz-legendRow">${legend}</div>
    <div class="hz-grid2 hz-grid2--equal">
      ${plotStack(L, "Left")}
      ${plotStack(R, "Right")}
    </div>
  `
}

```

```{ojs}
hz_q4DataL = hz_q4RespL?.data ?? []

  error: hz_q4HazRespL?.error || hz_q4HazRespR?.error || null
})

// Q5 — Scenario trajectories + uncertainty

// Q5 controls
viewof hz_q5_view = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["Chart", "chart"],
    ["Summary table", "table"]
  ]),
  { label: "", value: "chart" }
)

hz_q5HazardOptions = ["any", "dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"]

hz_formatQ5Hazard = (h) => {
  const s = String(h ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()
  if (s === "any") return "Any"
  if (s === "dry (any)") return "Dry"
  if (s === "heat (any)") return "Heat"
  if (s === "wet (any)") return "Wet"
  return String(h ?? "")
}

viewof hz_q5_hazards = hz_safeEnhancedMultiSelect(
  (hz_q5HazardOptions ?? []).map(v => ({ value: v, label: hz_formatQ5Hazard(v) })),
  {
    label: "",
    value: hz_q5HazardOptions,
    placeholder: "Search hazards…"
  }
)

viewof hz_q5_scale = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["Absolute value", "abs"],
    ["Relative to historic baseline", "idx"],
    ["Difference from historic baseline", "diff"]
  ]),
  { label: "", value: "abs" }
)

viewof hz_q5_showUncertainty = Inputs.toggle({ label: "", value: false })
viewof hz_q5_showLines = Inputs.toggle({ label: "", value: true })
viewof hz_q5_freeY = Inputs.toggle({ label: "", value: true })

viewof hz_q5_chartHeight = Inputs.range([420, 980], {
  label: "",
  step: 10,
  value: 720
})

// Build scenario/timeframe pairs from the shared hz_scenXTime list 
hz_q5ScenarioPairsUniq = {
  const seen = new Set()
  const out = []
  for (const st of (hz_scenXTime ?? [])) {
    const p = hz_parseScenXTime(st)
    const scenario = String(p?.scenario ?? "")
    const timeframe = String(p?.timeframe ?? "")
    const k = `${scenario}|${timeframe}`
    if (!scenario) continue
    if (seen.has(k)) continue
    seen.add(k)
    out.push({ scenario, timeframe })
  }
  return out
}

// Q5 request
hz_q5Req = {
  const urls = [hz_src1?.url, hz_src2?.url].filter(Boolean)
  if (!urls.length) return { ok: false, error: "Missing dataset_url(s) for Q5." }

  return {
    ok: true,
    body: {
      dataset_urls: urls,
      geo: hz_geoFilterReq,
      scenario_time: hz_q5ScenarioPairsUniq,
      commodities: hz_selectedCommoditiesForReq ?? [],
      hazard_vars: null,
      method: hz_method,
      commodity_group: hz_selectedCommodGroup,
      severities: [hz_severity],
      hazards: ["any", "dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"],
      include_rollups: true,
      include_detail_hazards: false,
      n_gcm_for_ci: 5
    }
  }
}

mutable hz_q5Busy = false

hz_q5Resp = (hz_q5Req?.ok)
  ? await hz_keepScroll((async () => {
      mutable hz_q5Busy = true
      try {
        return await hz_apiDebouncedCached("q5", "/api/v1/hz/q5", hz_q5Req.body, { ttlMs: 60000, debounceMs: 250 })
      } finally {
        mutable hz_q5Busy = false
      }
    })())
  : { ok: false, error: hz_q5Req?.error ?? "Q5 request is not ready." }

hz_q5SeriesAll = hz_q5Resp?.series ?? []
hz_q5Meta = ({
  ok: !!hz_q5Resp?.ok,
  cached: !!hz_q5Resp?.cached,
  error: hz_q5Resp?.error ?? null,
  has_value_sd: !!hz_q5Resp?.meta?.has_value_sd,
  n_gcm_for_ci: (hz_q5Resp?.meta?.n_gcm_for_ci ?? null)
})
// Scenario/timeframe options
hz_q5ScenarioOptions = {
  const isHistName = (s) => /hist|historic/i.test(String(s ?? ""))
  const opts = Array.from(new Set((hz_q5SeriesAll ?? []).map(d => String(d?.scenario ?? ""))))
    .filter((s) => s && !isHistName(s))
    .sort()
  return opts.length ? opts : ["ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370", "ssp585"]
}

hz_q5TimeframeOptions = {
  const opts = Array.from(new Set((hz_q5SeriesAll ?? []).map(d => String(d?.timeframe ?? ""))))
    .filter((t) => t && !/hist|historic/i.test(t))
    .sort()
  return opts.length ? opts : ["2021-2040", "2041-2060", "2061-2080", "2081-2100"]
}

viewof hz_q5_scenarios = hz_safeEnhancedMultiSelect(
  (hz_q5ScenarioOptions ?? []).map(v => ({ value: v, label: String(v ?? "").toUpperCase() })),
  {
    label: "",
    value: hz_q5ScenarioOptions,
    placeholder: "Search scenarios…"
  }
)

viewof hz_q5_timeframes = hz_safeEnhancedMultiSelect(
  (hz_q5TimeframeOptions ?? []).map(v => ({ value: v, label: String(v ?? "") })),
  {
    label: "",
    value: hz_q5TimeframeOptions,
    placeholder: "Search periods…"
  }
)

hz_q5RowsClean = {
  const n = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null
  }

  
  const pick = (d, keys) => {
    for (const k of keys) {
      const v = d?.[k]
      if (v != null && v !== "") return v
    }
    return null
  }

  return (hz_q5SeriesAll ?? []).map(d => {
    const value = n(d?.value)
    const value_sd = n(d?.value_sd)

    
    let value_low = n(pick(d, ["value_low", "ci_low", "p05", "q05", "lower", "low"]))
    let value_high = n(pick(d, ["value_high", "ci_high", "p95", "q95", "upper", "high"]))

    let unc_kind = null
    if (value_low != null && value_high != null) {
      unc_kind = "ci"
    } else if (value != null && value_sd != null) {
      // Fallback: ±1 SD around the mean
      value_low = value - value_sd
      value_high = value + value_sd
      unc_kind = "sd"
    }

    return {
      scenario: String(d?.scenario ?? ""),
      timeframe: String(d?.timeframe ?? ""),
      year: n(d?.year),
      hazard: String(d?.hazard ?? ""),
      value,
      value_sd,
      value_low,
      value_high,
      unc_kind
    }
  })
}

hz_q5BaselinesByHazard = {
  const isHist = (s) => /hist|historic/i.test(String(s ?? ""))
  const m = new Map()
  for (const r of (hz_q5RowsClean ?? [])) {
    if (!isHist(r?.scenario)) continue
    if (!r?.hazard) continue
    if (r?.value == null) continue
    if (!m.has(r.hazard)) m.set(r.hazard, r.value)
  }
  return m
}

hz_q5Filtered = {
  const isHist = (s) => /hist|historic/i.test(String(s ?? ""))
  const scenSel = (hz_q5_scenarios && hz_q5_scenarios.length) ? hz_q5_scenarios : hz_q5ScenarioOptions
  const tfSel = (hz_q5_timeframes && hz_q5_timeframes.length) ? hz_q5_timeframes : hz_q5TimeframeOptions

  const scenSet = new Set(scenSel.map(String))
  const tfSet = new Set(tfSel.map(String))

  const hazardSel = (hz_q5_hazards && hz_q5_hazards.length) ? hz_q5_hazards.map(String) : hz_q5HazardOptions.map(String)
  const hazardSet = new Set(hazardSel)

  const out = []
  for (const r of (hz_q5RowsClean ?? [])) {
    if (!r) continue
    if (!r.hazard) continue
    if (r.value == null || r.year == null) continue

    if (isHist(r.scenario)) {
      out.push(r) // keep for baselines only
      continue
    }

    if (!scenSet.has(String(r.scenario))) continue
    if (!tfSet.has(String(r.timeframe))) continue
    if (!hazardSet.has(String(r.hazard))) continue

    out.push(r)
  }

  out.sort((a, b) => (a.year - b.year) || String(a.scenario).localeCompare(String(b.scenario)) || String(a.hazard).localeCompare(String(b.hazard)))
  return out
}

// Apply scale transform (absolute vs index-to-historic vs difference-from-historic)
hz_q5PlotRows = {
  const mode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")
  const base = hz_q5BaselinesByHazard

  const attachRawBaseline = (r) => ({
    ...r,
    baseline_raw: (() => {
      const b = base?.get?.(r?.hazard)
      return Number.isFinite(Number(b)) ? Number(b) : null
    })(),
    value_raw: (r?.value == null ? null : Number(r.value)),
    value_low_raw: (r?.value_low == null ? null : Number(r.value_low)),
    value_high_raw: (r?.value_high == null ? null : Number(r.value_high)),
    value_sd_raw: (r?.value_sd == null ? null : Number(r.value_sd))
  })

  if (mode === "abs") {
    return (hz_q5Filtered ?? [])
      .filter(d => !/hist|historic/i.test(String(d?.scenario ?? "")))
      .map(attachRawBaseline)
  }

  const scaleRow = (r) => {
    const b = base?.get?.(r.hazard)
    if (b == null || b === 0) return null

    if (mode === "idx") {
      const sc = 100 / b
      const num = (x) => (x == null ? null : x * sc)
      return {
        ...r,
        baseline_raw: Number(b),
        value_raw: (r?.value == null ? null : Number(r.value)),
        value_low_raw: (r?.value_low == null ? null : Number(r.value_low)),
        value_high_raw: (r?.value_high == null ? null : Number(r.value_high)),
        value_sd_raw: (r?.value_sd == null ? null : Number(r.value_sd)),
        value: num(r.value),
        value_sd: num(r.value_sd),
        value_low: num(r.value_low),
        value_high: num(r.value_high)
      }
    }

    if (mode === "diff") {
      const diff = (x) => (x == null ? null : Number(x) - Number(b))
      return {
        ...r,
        baseline_raw: Number(b),
        value_raw: (r?.value == null ? null : Number(r.value)),
        value_low_raw: (r?.value_low == null ? null : Number(r.value_low)),
        value_high_raw: (r?.value_high == null ? null : Number(r.value_high)),
        value_sd_raw: (r?.value_sd == null ? null : Number(r.value_sd)),
        value: diff(r.value),
        value_sd: (r?.value_sd == null ? null : Number(r.value_sd)),
        value_low: diff(r.value_low),
        value_high: diff(r.value_high)
      }
    }

    return attachRawBaseline(r)
  }

  const out = []
  for (const r of (hz_q5Filtered ?? [])) {
    if (/hist|historic/i.test(String(r?.scenario ?? ""))) continue
    const rr = scaleRow(r)
    if (rr && rr.value != null) out.push(rr)
  }
  return out
}

hz_q5PlotRowsJittered = {
  const rows = hz_q5PlotRows ?? []
  if (!rows.length) return []

  const scenOrder = (hz_q5_scenarios && hz_q5_scenarios.length) ? hz_q5_scenarios.map(String) : hz_q5ScenarioOptions.map(String)
  const uniqueScen = Array.from(new Set(scenOrder))
  const n = uniqueScen.length
  const span = 0.70
  const step = (n > 1) ? (span / (n - 1)) : 0
  const offset = new Map(uniqueScen.map((s, i) => [s, (n > 1 ? (-span / 2 + i * step) : 0)]))

  return rows.map(r => ({
    ...r,
    xj: (Number(r.year) + (offset.get(String(r.scenario)) ?? 0))
  }))
}

// Baseline lines (historic exposure) shown as dashed rules
hz_q5BaselineRules = {
  const mode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")
  const hazards = ["any", "dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"]
  const out = []
  for (const h of hazards) {
    const b = hz_q5BaselinesByHazard?.get?.(h)
    if (mode === "idx") {
      if (b != null) out.push({ hazard: h, baseline: 100 })
    } else if (mode === "diff") {
      if (b != null) out.push({ hazard: h, baseline: 0 })
    } else {
      if (b != null) out.push({ hazard: h, baseline: b })
    }
  }
  return out
}


hz_q5Plot = {
  if (hz_q5Meta?.error) return html`<div class="warn"><b>Q5 query failed:</b><br>${hz_q5Meta.error}</div>`

  const rowsJ = hz_q5PlotRowsJittered ?? []
  if (!rowsJ.length) return html`<div class="hz-loading">Loading chart…</div>`

  const selectedHazards = (hz_q5_hazards && hz_q5_hazards.length) ? hz_q5_hazards.map(String) : hz_q5HazardOptions.map(String)
  const hazardDomain = (hz_q5HazardOptions ?? []).map(String).filter(h => selectedHazards.includes(h))
  const showMultiHazards = hazardDomain.length !== 1
  const showUnc = !!hz_q5_showUncertainty
  const showLines = !!hz_q5_showLines
  const freeY = !!hz_q5_freeY
  const scaleMode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")

  const years = Array.from(new Set(rowsJ.map(d => Math.round(Number(d.year)))))
    .filter(Number.isFinite)
    .sort((a, b) => a - b)

  const xVals = rowsJ.map(d => Number(d.xj)).filter(Number.isFinite)
  const xMin = xVals.length ? Math.min(...xVals) : (years.length ? years[0] : null)
  const xMax = xVals.length ? Math.max(...xVals) : (years.length ? years[years.length - 1] : null)
  const padYears = (xMin != null && xMax != null && xMin === xMax) ? 5 : 1.5
  const xDomain = (xMin != null && xMax != null) ? [xMin - padYears, xMax + padYears] : undefined
  const tickYears = years

  const fmtAbs = (v) => hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: true })
  const fmtIdx = (v) => hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 0, compact: false })
  const fmt = (v) => (scaleMode === "idx" ? fmtIdx(v) : fmtAbs(v))
  const tickFmtY = (d) => (scaleMode === "idx" ? fmtIdx(d) : fmtAbs(d))
  const fmtScenario = (s) => String(s ?? "").toUpperCase()
  const yLabel = (scaleMode === "idx")
    ? "Exposure index (historic = 100)"
    : (scaleMode === "diff")
      ? "Difference from historic baseline"
      : (hz_varLabelAbs ?? "Exposure")
  const yLabelDisplay = String(yLabel ?? "").replace(/^↑\s*/, "").trim()

  const normalizedDomain = (dom) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(dom) || dom.length !== 2) return undefined
    const a = Number(dom[0])
    const b = Number(dom[1])
    if (!Number.isFinite(a) || !Number.isFinite(b) || a === b) return undefined
    return a < b ? [a, b] : [b, a]
  }

  const valuesForHazard = (haz) => {
    const vals = []
    for (const d of (rowsJ ?? [])) {
      if (String(d?.hazard ?? "") !== String(haz)) continue
      const v = Number(d?.value)
      if (Number.isFinite(v)) vals.push(v)
      if (showUnc) {
        const lo = Number(d?.value_low)
        const hi = Number(d?.value_high)
        if (Number.isFinite(lo)) vals.push(lo)
        if (Number.isFinite(hi)) vals.push(hi)
      }
    }
    return vals
  }

  const valuesAll = hazardDomain.flatMap(h => valuesForHazard(h))
  const sharedYDomain = (() => {
    if (!valuesAll.length) return undefined
    const lo = Math.min(...valuesAll)
    const hi = Math.max(...valuesAll)
    const span = hi - lo
    const pad = span > 0 ? span * 0.08 : Math.max(Math.abs(hi || 0) * 0.05, 1)
    return normalizedDomain([lo - pad, hi + pad])
  })()

  const yDomainFor = (haz) => {
    const vals = valuesForHazard(haz)
    if (!vals.length) return undefined
    const lo = Math.min(...vals)
    const hi = Math.max(...vals)
    const span = hi - lo
    const pad = span > 0 ? span * 0.08 : Math.max(Math.abs(hi || 0) * 0.05, 1)
    return normalizedDomain([lo - pad, hi + pad])
  }

  const baseRules = (hz_q5BaselineRules ?? []).filter(d => hazardDomain.includes(String(d.hazard)))
  const baseForOne = (h) => {
    const r = baseRules.find(d => String(d.hazard) === String(h))
    return r ? Number(r.baseline) : null
  }

  const yScaleFor = (haz, labelText = null) => {
    const dom = freeY ? yDomainFor(haz) : sharedYDomain
    return {
      label: labelText,
      grid: true,
      tickFormat: tickFmtY,
      ticks: 6,
      nice: true,
      ...(dom ? { domain: dom } : {})
    }
  }

  const titleFor = (d) => {
    const parts = [
      `${fmtScenario(d.scenario)}  ${String(d.timeframe ?? "")}`,
      `Hazard: ${String(d.hazard ?? "")}`,
      `${fmt(d.value)}`
    ]
    if (showUnc && d.value_low != null && d.value_high != null) {
      const lab = (d.unc_kind === "sd") ? "±1 SD" : "CI"
      parts.push(`${lab}: ${fmt(d.value_low)}–${fmt(d.value_high)}`)
    }
    return parts.join("\n")
  }

  const rowsOne = rowsJ.filter(d => hazardDomain.includes(String(d.hazard)))
  const scenarioDomain = (((hz_q5_scenarios && hz_q5_scenarios.length) ? hz_q5_scenarios : hz_q5ScenarioOptions) ?? [])
    .map(String)
    .filter(s => rowsOne.some(r => String(r?.scenario ?? "") === s))
  const sharedColor = { domain: scenarioDomain, scheme: "tableau10", legend: false }

  const makeMarks = (data, haz) => {
    const baseline = baseForOne(haz)
    const finiteRows = [...data]
      .filter(d => Number.isFinite(Number(d?.xj)) && Number.isFinite(Number(d?.year)) && Number.isFinite(Number(d?.value)))
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const sa = String(a?.scenario ?? "")
        const sb = String(b?.scenario ?? "")
        if (sa !== sb) return sa.localeCompare(sb)
        return Number(a?.xj ?? 0) - Number(b?.xj ?? 0)
      })

    const uncRows = finiteRows
      .map(d => {
        const loRaw = Number(d?.value_low)
        const hiRaw = Number(d?.value_high)
        if (!Number.isFinite(loRaw) || !Number.isFinite(hiRaw)) return null
        const lo = Math.min(loRaw, hiRaw)
        const hi = Math.max(loRaw, hiRaw)
        if (!Number.isFinite(lo) || !Number.isFinite(hi)) return null
        return { ...d, band_low: lo, band_high: hi }
      })
      .filter(Boolean)

    const uncBandRows = (() => {
      if (!showUnc || !uncRows.length) return []
      const groups = d3.group(uncRows, d => String(d?.scenario ?? ""))
      const out = []
      for (const [, arr] of groups) {
        const sorted = [...arr].sort((a, b) => Number(a?.xj ?? 0) - Number(b?.xj ?? 0))
        const distinctX = new Set(sorted.map(d => Number(d?.xj))).size
        if (sorted.length < 2 || distinctX < 2) continue
        if (sorted.some(d => !Number.isFinite(Number(d?.band_low)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(d?.band_high)) || Number(d?.band_low) > Number(d?.band_high))) continue
        out.push(...sorted)
      }
      return out
    })()

    return [
      ...(baseline != null ? [Plot.ruleY([baseline], { strokeDasharray: "4,4", opacity: 0.55 })] : []),
      ...(showUnc && uncBandRows.length ? [
        Plot.areaY(uncBandRows, {
          x: "xj",
          y1: "band_low",
          y2: "band_high",
          z: "scenario",
          fill: "scenario",
          fillOpacity: 0.12,
          stroke: null,
          curve: "linear"
        })
      ] : []),
      ...(showUnc ? [
        Plot.ruleX(uncRows, {
          x: "xj",
          y1: "band_low",
          y2: "band_high",
          stroke: "scenario",
          opacity: 0.55,
          strokeWidth: 1.8,
          strokeLinecap: "round"
        })
      ] : []),
      ...(showLines ? [Plot.line(finiteRows, {
        x: "xj",
        y: "value",
        z: "scenario",
        stroke: "scenario",
        opacity: 0.95,
        strokeWidth: 2.5,
        curve: "linear"
      })] : []),
      Plot.dot(finiteRows, {
        x: "xj",
        y: "value",
        z: "scenario",
        stroke: "scenario",
        fill: "scenario",
        r: 4.5,
        title: titleFor
      })
    ]
  }

  const w = (typeof width === "number" && Number.isFinite(width)) ? width : 1100
  const plotWidth = Math.min(1400, w)
  const totalHeight = Number(hz_q5_chartHeight ?? 720)

  if (!showMultiHazards) {
    const oneHaz = hazardDomain[0]
    const plotOpts = {
      width: plotWidth,
      height: totalHeight,
      marginLeft: 84,
      marginRight: 96,
      marginTop: 10,
      marginBottom: 44,
      x: {
        label: "Year",
        grid: true,
        domain: xDomain,
        ticks: tickYears,
        tickFormat: (d) => String(Math.round(d)),
        nice: false
      },
      y: yScaleFor(oneHaz, yLabel),
      color: { ...sharedColor, legend: true, label: "Scenario" },
      marks: makeMarks(rowsOne.filter(d => String(d.hazard) === String(oneHaz)), oneHaz)
    }
    return Plot.plot(plotOpts)
  }

  const cols = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, hazardDomain.length))
  const rowsCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hazardDomain.length / cols))
  const gap = 16
  const panelW = Math.max(320, Math.floor((plotWidth - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols))
  const panelH = Math.max(260, Math.floor((totalHeight - gap * (rowsCount - 1)) / rowsCount))
  const legend = Plot.legend({ color: { ...sharedColor, legend: true, label: "Scenario" }, columns: Math.min(4, Math.max(1, scenarioDomain.length || 1)) })

  const buildPanel = (haz, idx) => {
    const data = rowsOne.filter(d => String(d.hazard) === String(haz))
    return html`
      <div class="hz-sideCard hz-sideCard--plot">
        <div class="hz-sideCard__body">
          <div class="hz-mini__title" style="margin:0 0 12px 0;line-height:1.15;">${hz_formatQ5Hazard(haz)}</div>
          ${Plot.plot({
            width: panelW,
            height: panelH,
            style: { overflow: "visible" },
            marginLeft: 72,
            marginRight: 18,
            marginTop: 6,
            marginBottom: 40,
            x: {
              label: "Year",
              grid: true,
              domain: xDomain,
              ticks: tickYears,
              tickFormat: (d) => String(Math.round(d)),
              nice: false
            },
            y: yScaleFor(haz, null),
            color: sharedColor,
            marks: makeMarks(data, haz)
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    `
  }

  return html`
    <div class="hz-legendRow">${legend}</div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0, 1fr);column-gap:10px;align-items:start;">
      <div style="writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);text-align:center;color:var(--theme-foreground-muted, #6b7280);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1;padding-top:84px;">
        ${yLabelDisplay}
      </div>
      <div style="display:grid;gap:${gap}px;grid-template-columns:repeat(${cols}, minmax(0, 1fr));align-items:start;">
        ${hazardDomain.map((haz, idx) => buildPanel(haz, idx))}
      </div>
    </div>
  `
}
hz_q5_chartHost = html`
  <div class="hz-chartWrap ${hz_q5Busy ? "hz-chartWrap--busy" : ""}">
    ${hz_q5Plot}
    <div class="hz-chartNote">
      ${md`${hz_t("sections.q5.chartNote")}`}
    </div>
  </div>
`

hz_q5_settingsWrap = html`
  <div class="hz-qToolbar__right">
    <div class="hz-inlineToggles hz-inlineToggles--grid">
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q5-label-scale">Scale</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_scale)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--grow"><span id="hz-q5-label-hazards">Hazards</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_hazards)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--grow"><span id="hz-q5-label-scenarios">Scenarios</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_scenarios)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--grow"><span id="hz-q5-label-periods">Periods</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_timeframes)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q5-label-uncertainty">Uncertainty</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_showUncertainty)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q5-label-lines">Lines</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_showLines)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q5-label-freey">Free Y axis</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_freeY)}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--range"><span id="hz-q5-label-height">Height</span>${hz_noJumpInput(viewof hz_q5_chartHeight)}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
`

// Q5 — Summary table + dynamic insights


// Baseline for a hazard under the current scale
hz_q5BaselineFor = (haz) => {
  const h = String(haz ?? "")
  const mode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")
  if (mode === "idx") return 100
  if (mode === "diff") return 0
  const v = hz_q5BaselinesByHazard?.get?.(h)
  return (v == null) ? null : Number(v)
}

// Table
hz_q5TableView = {
  if (hz_q5Meta?.error) return html`<div class="warn"><b>Q5 query failed:</b><br>${hz_q5Meta.error}</div>`

  const rows = hz_q5PlotRows ?? []
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div class="hz-loading"><span id="hz-q5-loading-table">Loading table…</span></div>`

  const fmtAbs = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: true }) : "—"
  }
  const fmtAbsFull = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false }) : "—"
  }
  const fmtPct = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? `${hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })}%` : "—"
  }

  const hasUnc = !!hz_q5Meta?.has_value_sd
  const scaleMode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")

  const out = (rows ?? [])
    .filter(r => {
      const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "").trim()
      const s = String(r?.scenario ?? "").trim()
      const tf = String(r?.timeframe ?? "").trim()
      return (r && tf &&
              h && h.toLowerCase() !== "null" &&
              s && s.toLowerCase() !== "null")
    })
    .map((r) => {
      const bShown = hz_q5BaselineFor(r.hazard)
      const bRaw = (r?.baseline_raw == null ? null : Number(r.baseline_raw))
      const v = (r.value == null ? null : Number(r.value))
      const bbShown = (bShown == null ? null : Number(bShown))

      const delta = (bbShown == null || v == null || !Number.isFinite(bbShown) || !Number.isFinite(v))
        ? null
        : (v - bbShown)

      const pct = (scaleMode === "diff")
        ? ((bRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(bRaw) || bRaw === 0 || v == null || !Number.isFinite(v))
            ? null
            : (100 * v / bRaw))
        : ((bbShown == null || !Number.isFinite(bbShown) || bbShown === 0 || delta == null || !Number.isFinite(delta))
            ? null
            : (100 * delta / bbShown))

      const ciwRaw = (!hasUnc || r.value_low == null || r.value_high == null)
        ? null
        : (Number(r.value_high) - Number(r.value_low))

      const ciw = (ciwRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(ciwRaw) || ciwRaw <= 0) ? null : ciwRaw

      return ({
        "Hazard": String(r.hazard ?? ""),
        "Scenario": String(r.scenario ?? "").toUpperCase(),
        "Period": String(r.timeframe ?? ""),
        "Year": Number(r.year),
        "Value": v,
        "Baseline": (bbShown == null || !Number.isFinite(bbShown)) ? null : bbShown,
        "Historic baseline": (bRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(bRaw)) ? null : bRaw,
        "Δ vs baseline": (delta == null || !Number.isFinite(delta)) ? null : Number(delta),
        "Δ% vs baseline": (pct == null || !Number.isFinite(pct)) ? null : Number(pct),
        "CI width": ciw
      })
    })

  // Sort: hazard then year then scenario
  out.sort((a, b) =>
    String(a["Hazard"]).localeCompare(String(b["Hazard"])) ||
    (Number(a["Year"]) - Number(b["Year"])) ||
    String(a["Scenario"]).localeCompare(String(b["Scenario"]))
  )

  const valueLabel = (scaleMode === "idx") ? "Index" : (scaleMode === "diff" ? "Difference" : "Value")
  const baselineLabel = (scaleMode === "diff") ? "Historic baseline" : "Baseline"

  // Rename columns dynamically
  const data = out.map((d) => ({
    ...d,
    [valueLabel]: d["Value"]
  }))

  const columns = (scaleMode === "diff")
    ? ["Hazard", "Scenario", "Period", "Year", valueLabel, baselineLabel, "Δ% vs baseline", "CI width"]
    : ["Hazard", "Scenario", "Period", "Year", valueLabel, "Baseline", "Δ vs baseline", "Δ% vs baseline", "CI width"]

  return hz_atlasTable(data, {
    columns,
    format: {
      "Year": (x) => Number.isFinite(Number(x)) ? String(Math.round(Number(x))) : "—",
      [valueLabel]: fmtAbsFull,
      [baselineLabel]: fmtAbsFull,
      "Baseline": fmtAbsFull,
      "Δ vs baseline": fmtAbsFull,
      "Δ% vs baseline": fmtPct,
      "CI width": fmtAbs
    },
    rows: data.length,
    height: null,
    width: {
      "Hazard": 150,
      "Scenario": 120,
      "Period": 150,
      "Year": 90,
      [valueLabel]: 150,
      [baselineLabel]: 150,
      "Baseline": 150,
      "Δ vs baseline": 150,
      "Δ% vs baseline": 140,
      "CI width": 120
    }
  })
}

hz_q5SummaryExport = {
  if (hz_q5Meta?.error) return { filename: "exposure_by_ssp_time_gcm", data: [] }

  const rows = hz_q5PlotRows ?? []
  if (!rows.length) return { filename: "exposure_by_ssp_time_gcm", data: [] }

  const hasUnc = !!hz_q5Meta?.has_value_sd
  const scaleMode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")
  const out = (rows ?? [])
    .filter(r => {
      const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "").trim()
      const s = String(r?.scenario ?? "").trim()
      const tf = String(r?.timeframe ?? "").trim()
      return (r && tf &&
              h && h.toLowerCase() !== "null" &&
              s && s.toLowerCase() !== "null")
    })
    .map((r) => {
      const bShown = hz_q5BaselineFor(r.hazard)
      const bRaw = (r?.baseline_raw == null ? null : Number(r.baseline_raw))
      const v = (r.value == null ? null : Number(r.value))
      const bbShown = (bShown == null ? null : Number(bShown))
      const delta = (bbShown == null || v == null || !Number.isFinite(bbShown) || !Number.isFinite(v))
        ? null
        : (v - bbShown)
      const pct = (scaleMode === "diff")
        ? ((bRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(bRaw) || bRaw === 0 || v == null || !Number.isFinite(v))
            ? null
            : (100 * v / bRaw))
        : ((bbShown == null || !Number.isFinite(bbShown) || bbShown === 0 || delta == null || !Number.isFinite(delta))
            ? null
            : (100 * delta / bbShown))
      const ciwRaw = (!hasUnc || r.value_low == null || r.value_high == null)
        ? null
        : (Number(r.value_high) - Number(r.value_low))
      const ciw = (ciwRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(ciwRaw) || ciwRaw <= 0) ? null : ciwRaw
      return ({
        "Hazard": String(r.hazard ?? ""),
        "Scenario": String(r.scenario ?? "").toUpperCase(),
        "Period": String(r.timeframe ?? ""),
        "Year": Number(r.year),
        "Value": v,
        "Baseline": (bbShown == null || !Number.isFinite(bbShown)) ? null : bbShown,
        "Historic baseline": (bRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(bRaw)) ? null : bRaw,
        "Δ vs baseline": (delta == null || !Number.isFinite(delta)) ? null : Number(delta),
        "Δ% vs baseline": (pct == null || !Number.isFinite(pct)) ? null : Number(pct),
        "CI width": ciw
      })
    })

  out.sort((a, b) =>
    String(a["Hazard"]).localeCompare(String(b["Hazard"])) ||
    (Number(a["Year"]) - Number(b["Year"])) ||
    String(a["Scenario"]).localeCompare(String(b["Scenario"]))
  )

  const valueLabel = (scaleMode === "idx") ? "Index" : (scaleMode === "diff" ? "Difference" : "Value")
  const baselineLabel = (scaleMode === "diff") ? "Historic baseline" : "Baseline"
  const data = out.map((d) => ({
    "Hazard": d["Hazard"],
    "Scenario": d["Scenario"],
    "Period": d["Period"],
    "Year": d["Year"],
    [valueLabel]: d["Value"],
    [baselineLabel]: d[baselineLabel],
    ...(scaleMode === "diff" ? {} : { "Δ vs baseline": d["Δ vs baseline"] }),
    "Δ% vs baseline": d["Δ% vs baseline"],
    "CI width": d["CI width"]
  }))

  return {
    filename: "exposure_by_ssp_time_gcm",
    data
  }
}

hz_q5_tableHost = html`
  <div class="hz-tableWrap ${hz_q5Busy ? "hz-tableWrap--busy" : ""}">
    ${hz_q5TableView}
  </div>
`

// Q5: keep results host stable to avoid page scroll jumps when toggling controls
hz_q5_resultsNode = html`
  <div class="hz-qResults">
    <div class="hz-qRes hz-qRes--chart"></div>
    <div class="hz-qRes hz-qRes--table"></div>
  </div>
`

hz_q5_resultsMount = {
  const root = hz_q5_resultsNode
  const chartDiv = root?.querySelector?.(".hz-qRes--chart")
  const tableDiv = root?.querySelector?.(".hz-qRes--table")
  if (chartDiv) chartDiv.replaceChildren(hz_q5_chartHost)
  if (tableDiv) tableDiv.replaceChildren(hz_q5_tableHost)
  return root
}

hz_q5_wireViewToggle = {
  const viewEl = viewof hz_q5_view
  const root = hz_q5_resultsNode
  const chartDiv = root?.querySelector?.(".hz-qRes--chart")
  const tableDiv = root?.querySelector?.(".hz-qRes--table")
  const update = () => {
    const v = String(viewEl?.value ?? "chart")
    if (chartDiv) chartDiv.style.display = (v === "table") ? "none" : ""
    if (tableDiv) tableDiv.style.display = (v === "table") ? "" : "none"
  }
  update()
  if (viewEl && !viewEl.__hz_q5_view_wired) {
    viewEl.__hz_q5_view_wired = true
    viewEl.addEventListener("input", update)
    viewEl.addEventListener("change", update)
  }
  return null
}

hz_q5_wireHazardCtl = null

// Insights helper: table renderer
hz_q5_smallTable = (cols, rows) => {
  const safeRows = (Array.isArray(rows) && rows.length)
    ? rows.map(r => {
        const out = {}
        for (const c of cols) out[c] = (r?.[c] == null ? "—" : r[c])
        return out
      })
    : [Object.fromEntries(cols.map(c => [c, "—"]))]

  const widths = {}
  for (const c of cols) {
    const k = String(c ?? "").toLowerCase()
    if (k.includes("hazard")) widths[c] = 140
    else if (k.includes("scenario")) widths[c] = 120
    else if (k.includes("period")) widths[c] = 150
    else if (k.includes("year")) widths[c] = 90
    else if (k.includes("ci")) widths[c] = 150
    else if (k.includes("delta%") || k.includes("δ%") || k.includes("%")) widths[c] = 140
    else if (k.includes("delta") || k.includes("δ") || k.includes("value")) widths[c] = 170
    else widths[c] = 160
  }

  return hz_atlasTable(safeRows, {
    columns: cols,
    sortable: true,
    widths
  })
}

hz_q5Insight = {
  const _langTick = masterLanguage
  const err = hz_q5Meta?.error
  if (err) return html`<div class="hz-muted">${hz_tpl("sections.q5.insight.unavailable", { err })}</div>`

  const rows = hz_q5PlotRows ?? []
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">${hz_t("sections.q5.insight.loading")}</div>`

  const fmt = (v) => hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: true })
  const fmtFull = (v) => hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })
  const fmtPct = (v) => `${hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })}%`

  const hazardsInView = (() => {
    const selectedHazards = (hz_q5_hazards && hz_q5_hazards.length) ? hz_q5_hazards.map(String) : hz_q5HazardOptions.map(String)
    const selectedSet = new Set(selectedHazards)
    const dom = ["any", "dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"]
    const present = new Set(rows.map(r => String(r.hazard)))
    return dom.filter(h => selectedSet.has(h) && present.has(h))
  })()

  // Latest row per hazard+scenario
  const latest = []
  for (const h of hazardsInView) {
    const byScen = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (String(r.hazard) !== String(h)) continue
      const s = String(r.scenario ?? "").trim()
      if (!s || s.toLowerCase() === "null") continue
      const prev = byScen.get(s)
      if (!prev || Number(r.year) > Number(prev.year)) byScen.set(s, r)
    }
    for (const r of byScen.values()) latest.push(r)
  }

  const hasUnc = !!hz_q5Meta?.has_value_sd
  const abs = Math.abs

  const withDeltas = latest.map((r) => {
    const b = hz_q5BaselineFor(r.hazard)
    const v = (r.value == null ? null : Number(r.value))
    const bb = (b == null ? null : Number(b))

    const delta = (bb == null || v == null || !Number.isFinite(bb) || !Number.isFinite(v))
      ? null
      : (v - bb)

    const pct = (bb == null || !Number.isFinite(bb) || bb === 0 || delta == null || !Number.isFinite(delta))
      ? null
      : (100 * delta / bb)

    const ciwRaw = (!hasUnc || r.value_low == null || r.value_high == null)
      ? null
      : (Number(r.value_high) - Number(r.value_low))

    const ciw = (ciwRaw == null || !Number.isFinite(ciwRaw) || ciwRaw <= 0) ? null : ciwRaw

    return { ...r, baseline: bb, delta, pct, ciw }
  })

  // Largest increase (positive Δ) + smallest change (min |Δ|) per hazard
  const topInc = []
  const lowInc = []
  for (const h of hazardsInView) {
    const xs = withDeltas
      .filter(d => String(d.hazard) === String(h))
      .filter(d => Number.isFinite(d.delta))

    if (!xs.length) continue

    xs.sort((a, b) => (b.delta - a.delta))
    topInc.push(xs[0])

    const minAbs = xs.reduce((best, cur) => (abs(cur.delta) < abs(best.delta) ? cur : best), xs[0])
    lowInc.push(minAbs)
  }

  const colsMain = [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.hazard"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.scenario"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.period"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.year"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.value"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.delta"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.deltaPct")]
  const rowToObj = (r) => ({
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.hazard")]: hz_hazardLabel(String(r.hazard ?? "")),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.scenario")]: String(r.scenario ?? "").toUpperCase(),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.period")]: String(r.timeframe ?? ""),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.year")]: Number.isFinite(Number(r.year)) ? String(Math.round(Number(r.year))) : "—",
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.value")]: (r.value == null ? "—" : fmtFull(r.value)),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.delta")]: (r.delta == null ? "—" : fmtFull(r.delta)),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.deltaPct")]: (r.pct == null ? "—" : fmtPct(r.pct))
  })

  // Uncertainty hotspots (widest CI among ALL plotted rows)
  const unc = (!hasUnc)
    ? []
    : (rows ?? [])
        .filter(r => {
          const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "").trim()
          const s = String(r?.scenario ?? "").trim()
          return (r && r.value_low != null && r.value_high != null &&
                  h && h.toLowerCase() !== "null" &&
                  s && s.toLowerCase() !== "null")
        })
        .map(r => ({
          ...r,
          ciw: Number(r.value_high) - Number(r.value_low)
        }))
        .filter(r => Number.isFinite(r.ciw) && r.ciw > 0)
        .sort((a,b) => (b.ciw - a.ciw))
        .slice(0, 6)

  const colsUnc = [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.hazard"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.scenario"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.period"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.year"), hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.ciWidth")]
  const uncRows = unc.map(r => ({
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.hazard")]: hz_hazardLabel(String(r.hazard ?? "")),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.scenario")]: String(r.scenario ?? "").toUpperCase(),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.period")]: String(r.timeframe ?? ""),
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.year")]: Number.isFinite(Number(r.year)) ? String(Math.round(Number(r.year))) : "—",
    [hz_t("sections.q5.insight.columns.ciWidth")]: fmtFull(r.ciw)
  }))

  const scaleMode = String(hz_q5_scale ?? "abs")
  const lead = (scaleMode === "idx")
    ? hz_t("sections.q5.insight.leadIndexed")
    : (scaleMode === "diff")
      ? hz_t("sections.q5.insight.leadDifference")
      : hz_t("sections.q5.insight.leadAbsolute")

  return html`
    <div class="hz-q4InsightBlock">
      <div class="hz-q4InsightLead">${md`${lead}`}</div>

      <div>
        <div class="hz-q4Subhead">${md`${hz_t("sections.q5.insight.titles.largestIncrease")}`}</div>
        ${hz_q5_smallTable(colsMain, topInc.map(rowToObj))}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="hz-q4Subhead">${md`${hz_t("sections.q5.insight.titles.smallestChange")}`}</div>
        ${hz_q5_smallTable(colsMain, lowInc.map(rowToObj))}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="hz-q4Subhead">${md`${hz_t("sections.q5.insight.titles.uncertaintyHotspots")}`}</div>
        ${hz_q5_smallTable(colsUnc, uncRows)}
        ${uncRows.length ? html`` : html`<div class="hz-muted">${md`${hasUnc
          ? hz_t("sections.q5.insight.uncertaintyMissing")
          : hz_t("sections.q5.insight.uncertaintyNoSd")}`}</div>`}
      </div>
      ${hz_renderSummaryDownloadButton(hz_q5SummaryExport, "exposure_by_ssp_time_gcm")}
    </div>
  `
}

hz_q4Rows = {
  const nnum = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0
  }
  const mapL = new Map((hz_q4DataL ?? []).map(d => [String(d?.admin_name ?? d?.admin ?? "Unknown"), nnum(d?.total)]))
  const mapR = new Map((hz_q4DataR ?? []).map(d => [String(d?.admin_name ?? d?.admin ?? "Unknown"), nnum(d?.total)]))
  const names = Array.from(new Set([...mapL.keys(), ...mapR.keys()]))
  const rows = names.map(name => ({ name, total1: nnum(mapL.get(name)), total2: nnum(mapR.get(name)) }))
  rows.sort((a,b) => (b.total2 - a.total2) || (b.total1 - a.total1))
  return rows.slice(0, Math.max(1, Number(hz_q4_topNEff ?? 10) || 10))
}

// Q4 helper rows: normalize hazard-by-admin payload
hz_q4HazRowsL_norm = {
  const src = Array.isArray(hz_q4HazDataL) && hz_q4HazDataL.length ? hz_q4HazDataL : (hz_q4DataL ?? []).map((d) => ({ ...d, hazard: "any" }))
  return src
    .map((d) => ({
      admin: String(d?.admin_name ?? d?.admin ?? d?.name ?? "Unknown"),
      hazard: String(d?.hazard ?? "any"),
      total: Number(d?.total ?? d?.value ?? 0)
    }))
    .filter((d) => d.admin && Number.isFinite(d.total))
}

hz_q4HazRowsR_norm = {
  const src = Array.isArray(hz_q4HazDataR) && hz_q4HazDataR.length ? hz_q4HazDataR : (hz_q4DataR ?? []).map((d) => ({ ...d, hazard: "any" }))
  return src
    .map((d) => ({
      admin: String(d?.admin_name ?? d?.admin ?? d?.name ?? "Unknown"),
      hazard: String(d?.hazard ?? "any"),
      total: Number(d?.total ?? d?.value ?? 0)
    }))
    .filter((d) => d.admin && Number.isFinite(d.total))
}

hz_q4NonCompoundBuckets = (rows) => {
  const byAdmin = new Map()
  const add = (admin, hazard, v) => {
    const key = `${admin}||${hazard}`
    byAdmin.set(key, (byAdmin.get(key) || 0) + v)
  }

  for (const r of (rows ?? [])) {
    const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
    const admin = String(r?.admin ?? "")
    if (!admin) continue
    const v = Number(r?.total ?? 0)
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue

    if (h === "any") add(admin, "any", v)

    if (h && h !== "any" && h !== "no hazard") {
      if (h.includes("dry")) add(admin, "dry (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("heat")) add(admin, "heat (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("wet")) add(admin, "wet (any)", v)
    }
  }

  const out = []
  for (const [key, total] of byAdmin.entries()) {
    const [admin, hazard] = key.split("||")
    out.push({ admin, hazard, total })
  }
  return out
}

hz_q4CompoundExclusive = (rows) => {
  const out = []
  for (const r of (rows ?? [])) {
    const h0 = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
    const admin = String(r?.admin ?? "")
    if (!admin) continue
    const v = Number(r?.total ?? 0)
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue

    if (h0 === "dry") out.push({ hazard: "dry (only)", admin, total: v })
    else if (h0 === "heat") out.push({ hazard: "heat (only)", admin, total: v })
    else if (h0 === "wet") out.push({ hazard: "wet (only)", admin, total: v })
    else if (h0 === "dry+heat" || h0 === "dry+wet" || h0 === "heat+wet" || h0 === "dry+heat+wet") out.push({ hazard: h0, admin, total: v })
  }
  return out
}

hz_q4CompoundSimplified = (rows) => {
  const bucket = (h) => {
    const h0 = String(h).replace(" (only)", "")
    const n = h0.split("+").filter(Boolean).length
    if (n === 1) return "1 hazard"
    if (n === 2) return "2 hazards"
    if (n === 3) return "3 hazards"
    return null
  }

  const agg = new Map()
  for (const r of (rows ?? [])) {
    const admin = String(r?.admin ?? "")
    if (!admin) continue
    const b = bucket(String(r?.hazard ?? ""))
    if (!b) continue
    const key = `${admin}||${b}`
    const v = Number(r?.total ?? 0)
    if (!Number.isFinite(v)) continue
    agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + v)
  }

  const out = []
  for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
    const [admin, hazard] = key.split("||")
    out.push({ admin, hazard, total })
  }
  return out
}

hz_q4HazMerge = (rowsL, rowsR) => {
  const keyOf = (d) => `${d?.admin ?? ""}||${d?.hazard ?? ""}`
  const mapL = new Map((rowsL ?? []).map((d) => [keyOf(d), Number(d?.total ?? 0)]))
  const mapR = new Map((rowsR ?? []).map((d) => [keyOf(d), Number(d?.total ?? 0)]))
  const keys = Array.from(new Set([...mapL.keys(), ...mapR.keys()]))

  return keys.map((k) => {
    const [admin, hazard] = k.split("||")
    const total1 = Number(mapL.get(k) || 0)
    const total2 = Number(mapR.get(k) || 0)
    return { admin, hazard, total1, total2, diff: total2 - total1 }
  })
}

hz_q4Set_compound_full = hz_q4HazMerge(hz_q4CompoundExclusive(hz_q4HazRowsL_norm), hz_q4CompoundExclusive(hz_q4HazRowsR_norm))
hz_q4Set_compound_simple = hz_q4HazMerge(hz_q4CompoundSimplified(hz_q4CompoundExclusive(hz_q4HazRowsL_norm)), hz_q4CompoundSimplified(hz_q4CompoundExclusive(hz_q4HazRowsR_norm)))
hz_q4Set_noncompound = hz_q4HazMerge(hz_q4NonCompoundBuckets(hz_q4HazRowsL_norm), hz_q4NonCompoundBuckets(hz_q4HazRowsR_norm))

hz_q4HazSetActive = {
  if (!!hz_q4_showCompound) {
    return hz_q4_simplifyCompound ? (hz_q4Set_compound_simple ?? []) : (hz_q4Set_compound_full ?? [])
  }
  return hz_q4Set_noncompound ?? []
}

hz_q4HazLevels = (
  !!hz_q4_showCompound
    ? (!!hz_q4_simplifyCompound
        ? ["1 hazard", "2 hazards", "3 hazards"]
        : ["dry (only)", "heat (only)", "wet (only)", "dry+heat", "dry+wet", "heat+wet", "dry+heat+wet"])
    : ["dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)", "any"]
)

hz_q4RowsChart = {
  const set = Array.isArray(hz_q4HazSetActive) ? hz_q4HazSetActive : []
  const hazLevels = Array.isArray(hz_q4HazLevels) ? hz_q4HazLevels : []
  if (!set.length) return []

  const totalL_all = set.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r?.total1 ?? 0), 0)
  const totalR_all = set.reduce((s, r) => s + Number(r?.total2 ?? 0), 0)
  const valL = (r) => hz_rel ? (totalL_all ? (100 * Number(r?.total1 ?? 0) / totalL_all) : 0) : Number(r?.total1 ?? 0)
  const valR = (r) => hz_rel ? (totalR_all ? (100 * Number(r?.total2 ?? 0) / totalR_all) : 0) : Number(r?.total2 ?? 0)

  const rankMap = new Map()
  if (hz_q4_difference) {
    const useAny = hazLevels.includes("any")
    if (useAny) {
      for (const r of set) {
        if (String(r?.hazard ?? "") !== "any") continue
        rankMap.set(String(r?.admin ?? ""), Math.abs(valR(r) - valL(r)))
      }
    } else {
      const tmp = new Map()
      for (const r of set) {
        const admin = String(r?.admin ?? "")
        tmp.set(admin, (tmp.get(admin) || 0) + (valR(r) - valL(r)))
      }
      for (const [admin, delta] of tmp.entries()) rankMap.set(admin, Math.abs(delta))
    }
  } else {
    const useAny = hazLevels.includes("any")
    if (useAny) {
      for (const r of set) {
        if (String(r?.hazard ?? "") !== "any") continue
        rankMap.set(String(r?.admin ?? ""), valR(r))
      }
    } else {
      for (const r of set) {
        const admin = String(r?.admin ?? "")
        rankMap.set(admin, (rankMap.get(admin) || 0) + valR(r))
      }
    }
  }

  const n = Math.max(1, Number(hz_q4_topNEff ?? 10) || 10)
  const topAdmins = Array.from(rankMap.entries())
    .sort((a,b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, n)
    .map(([a]) => a)

  const idx = new Map(topAdmins.map((a, i) => [a, i]))
  const hidx = new Map(hazLevels.map((h, i) => [h, i]))

  const out = set
    .filter((r) => topAdmins.includes(String(r?.admin ?? "")) && hazLevels.includes(String(r?.hazard ?? "")))
    .map((r) => {
      const left = valL(r)
      const right = valR(r)
      return {
        admin: String(r?.admin ?? ""),
        hazard: String(r?.hazard ?? ""),
        total1: Number(r?.total1 ?? 0),
        total2: Number(r?.total2 ?? 0),
        value1: left,
        value2: right,
        delta: right - left
      }
    })
    .sort((a,b) => (idx.get(a.admin) - idx.get(b.admin)) || (hidx.get(a.hazard) - hidx.get(b.hazard)))

  return out
}

hz_q4Chart = {
  const rows = hz_q4RowsChart ?? []
  if (!rows.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">No data.</div>`

  const subtitle = `${hz_geoLabel} • ${hz_commodityLabel} • Left: ${hz_s1.label} • Right: ${hz_s2.label}`
  const admins = Array.from(new Set(rows.map((d) => d.admin)))
  const hazLevels = hz_q4HazLevels ?? []

  const groupGap = 1
  const slotPx = hz_q4_showCompound ? 14 : 15
  const perAdmin = Math.max(
    hz_q4_showCompound ? 70 : 62,
    hazLevels.length * slotPx + groupGap * 12
  )

  const height = Math.max(
    360,
    admins.length * perAdmin,
    Number(hz_q4_chartHeight ?? 520)
  )

  const plotW =
    (hz_plotWidth ?? 0) >= 980
      ? Math.floor((hz_plotWidth - 16) / 2)
      : hz_plotWidth

  const xLabel = hz_rel ? "Percent of selected total (%)" : (hz_varLabelAbs ?? "Exposure")
  const xLabelDiff = hz_rel ? "Δ percentage points (Right − Left)" : "Δ exposure (Right − Left)"
  const fmt = (x) => hz_rel ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })}%` : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })
  const fmtDiff = (x) => hz_rel ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })} pp` : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })
  const tickFmt = (x) => hz_rel ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })}%` : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 0 })

  const sharedColor = hz_hazardColorConfig(hazLevels, true)
  const legend = Plot.legend({ color: sharedColor, columns: Math.min(4, Math.max(1, hazLevels.length || 1)) })

  const slotKey = (admin, hazard) => `${admin}__haz__${hazard}`
  const gapKey = (admin) => `${admin}__gap__`

  const buildGroupedLayout = (sourceRows, hazards) => {
    const domain = []
    const tickLabelMap = new Map()
    const midIdx = Math.floor((hazards.length - 1) / 2)
    const midHazard = hazards[midIdx] ?? hazards[0] ?? null

    for (const admin of admins) {
      for (const hazard of hazards) domain.push(slotKey(admin, hazard))
      if (midHazard) tickLabelMap.set(slotKey(admin, midHazard), admin)
      domain.push(gapKey(admin))
    }

    const data = (sourceRows ?? [])
      .filter((d) => admins.includes(d?.admin) && hazards.includes(String(d?.hazard ?? "")))
      .map((d) => ({
        ...d,
        admin: d.admin,
        hazard: String(d.hazard),
        value: Number(d?.value ?? 0),
        slot: slotKey(d.admin, String(d.hazard))
      }))

    return { data, domain, tickLabelMap }
  }

  const groupedBarMark = (layout) => Plot.barX(layout.data, {
    x: "value",
    y: "slot",
    fill: "hazard",
    insetTop: 1,
    insetBottom: 1
  })

  const groupedTipMark = (layout, valueFormatter) => Plot.tip(
    layout.data,
    Plot.pointerY({
      x: "value",
      y: "slot",
      fill: "hazard",
      maxRadius: 80,
      channels: {
        adminLabel: { value: (d) => d?.admin ?? "—", label: "Geography" },
        hazardLabel: { value: (d) => d?.hazard ?? "—", label: "Hazard" }
      },
      format: {
        adminLabel: true,
        hazardLabel: true,
        x: (v) => valueFormatter(v),
        y: false,
        fill: false
      }
    })
  )

  const makeGroupedSidePlot = (title, valueKey) => {
    const sourceRows = rows
      .filter((r) => admins.includes(r?.admin) && hazLevels.includes(String(r?.hazard ?? "")))
      .map((r) => ({
        admin: r.admin,
        hazard: String(r.hazard),
        value: Number(r?.[valueKey] ?? 0)
      }))

    const layout = buildGroupedLayout(sourceRows, hazLevels)

    const plot = hz_tuneCategoricalPlot(
      Plot.plot({
        className: "hz-plot--q4",
        style: { fontSize: "20px" },
        height,
        width: plotW,
        marginLeft: 290,
        marginRight: 18,
        marginTop: 10,
        marginBottom: 84,
        x: { label: xLabel, labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 52, grid: true, tickFormat: tickFmt },
        y: {
          domain: layout.domain,
          label: null,
          tickFormat: (d) => layout.tickLabelMap.get(d) ?? "",
          tickSize: 0
        },
        color: { ...sharedColor, legend: false },
        marks: [Plot.ruleX([0]), groupedBarMark(layout), groupedTipMark(layout, fmt)]
      }),
      { yTickFontSize: 22, xTickFontSize: 14, yWrapChars: 18 }
    )

    return html`
      <div class="hz-mini hz-mini--stack">
        <div class="hz-mini__title">${title}</div>
        ${plot}
      </div>
    `
  }

  if (hz_q4_difference) {
    const diffSourceRows = rows.map((r) => ({
      admin: r.admin,
      hazard: String(r.hazard),
      value: Number(r?.delta ?? 0)
    }))
    const layout = buildGroupedLayout(diffSourceRows, hazLevels)

    const diffPlot = hz_tuneCategoricalPlot(
      Plot.plot({
        className: "hz-plot--q4",
        style: { fontSize: "20px" },
        height,
        width: hz_plotWidth,
        marginLeft: 290,
        marginRight: 18,
        marginTop: 10,
        marginBottom: 86,
        x: {
          grid: true,
          label: xLabelDiff,
          labelAnchor: "center",
          labelOffset: 52,
          tickFormat: (x) => hz_rel ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })}` : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 0 })
        },
        y: {
          domain: layout.domain,
          label: null,
          tickFormat: (d) => layout.tickLabelMap.get(d) ?? "",
          tickSize: 0
        },
        color: { ...sharedColor, legend: false },
        marks: [
          Plot.ruleX([0]),
          groupedBarMark(layout),
          groupedTipMark(layout, fmtDiff)
        ]
      }),
      { yTickFontSize: 22, xTickFontSize: 14, yWrapChars: 18 }
    )

    return html`
      <div class="hz-chartLegend">${legend}</div>
      ${diffPlot}
      <div class="hz-upsetCaption">${subtitle}</div>
      ${(!hz_q4HazMeta?.ok && !(hz_q4HazDataL?.length || hz_q4HazDataR?.length))
        ? html`<div class="hz-upsetCaption">Hazard-by-admin API not available yet; showing fallback "any" totals only.</div>`
        : html``}
    `
  }

  return html`
    <div class="hz-chartLegend">${legend}</div>
    <div class="hz-grid2 hz-grid2--equal">
      ${makeGroupedSidePlot(hz_s1.label, "value1")}
      ${makeGroupedSidePlot(hz_s2.label, "value2")}
    </div>
    <div class="hz-upsetCaption">${subtitle}</div>
    ${(!hz_q4HazMeta?.ok && !(hz_q4HazDataL?.length || hz_q4HazDataR?.length))
      ? html`<div class="hz-upsetCaption">Hazard-by-admin API not available yet; showing fallback "any" totals only.</div>`
      : html``}
  `
}

viewof hz_viewMode = {
  // Q1 only: Chart + Summary table
  const form = Inputs.radio(
    ["chart", "table"],
    {
      label: "",
      value: "chart",
      format: (v) => ({ chart: "Chart", table: "Summary table" }[v] ?? v),
    }
  )

  form.classList.add("hz-viewToggle")

  const getScroller = () =>
    document.scrollingElement ||
    document.querySelector("#quarto-content") ||
    document.documentElement ||
    document.body

  const preserveAnchor = () => {
    const sc = getScroller()
    const y0 = sc.scrollTop
    const anchor = document.getElementById("q1")
    const a0 = anchor ? anchor.getBoundingClientRect().top : 0

    const restore = () => {
      const sc2 = getScroller()
      const anchor2 = document.getElementById("q1")
      const a1 = anchor2 ? anchor2.getBoundingClientRect().top : 0
      sc2.scrollTop = y0 + (a1 - a0)
    }

    // Restore after reactive reflow
    setTimeout(() => {
      restore()
      requestAnimationFrame(restore)
      requestAnimationFrame(restore)
    }, 0)
  }

  form.addEventListener(
    "change",
    () => {
      try {
        document.activeElement?.blur?.()
      } catch (_) {}
      preserveAnchor()
    },
    true
  )

  return form
}

viewof hz_recordsSide = {
  const options = [
    { value: "left",  label: "Left" },
    { value: "right", label: "Right" }
  ];

  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "hz-tabs hz-tabs--small";

  const buttons = new Map();
  const paint = (v) => {
    for (const [val, btn] of buttons.entries()) btn.classList.toggle("is-active", val === v);
  };

  const set = (v, { silent = false } = {}) => {
    if (root.value === v) return;
    root.value = v;
    paint(v);
    if (!silent) root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };

  for (const op of options) {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "hz-tab";
    btn.textContent = op.label;
    btn.onclick = () => set(op.value);
    buttons.set(op.value, btn);
    root.appendChild(btn);
  }

  set("left", { silent: true });
  return root;
}

viewof hz_recordsSort = {
  const options = ["value_desc", "value_asc"]
  const labelMap = { value_desc: "Value ↓", value_asc: "Value ↑" }
  const sel = Inputs.select(options, {
    value: "value_desc",
    label: null,
    format: (d) => labelMap[d] ?? String(d)
  });
  sel.classList.add("hz-select");
  return sel;
}

viewof hz_recordsPageSize = {
  const options = [50, 100, 200, 500]
  const sel = Inputs.select(options, {
    value: 100,
    label: null,
    format: (d) => `${d} rows`
  });
  sel.classList.add("hz-select");
  return sel;
}

viewof hz_recordsPage = {
  const root = document.createElement("div");
  root.className = "hz-pager";
  root.value = 1;

  const prev = document.createElement("button");
  prev.type = "button";
  prev.className = "hz-btn hz-btn--sm";
  prev.textContent = "Prev";

  const label = document.createElement("div");
  label.className = "hz-pager__label";

  const next = document.createElement("button");
  next.type = "button";
  next.className = "hz-btn hz-btn--sm";
  next.textContent = "Next";

  const paint = () => { label.textContent = `Page ${root.value}`; };

  const set = (v, { silent = false } = {}) => {
    const n = Math.max(1, Number(v || 1));
    if (root.value === n) return;
    root.value = n;
    paint();
    if (!silent) root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };

  prev.onclick = () => set(root.value - 1);
  next.onclick = () => set(root.value + 1);

  root.appendChild(prev);
  root.appendChild(label);
  root.appendChild(next);

  paint();
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
hz_q1SummaryExport = {
  const rows = Array.isArray(hz_q1DisplayRows) ? hz_q1DisplayRows : []
  if (!rows.length) return { filename: "exposure_breakdown_by_hazard", data: [] }

  const usePct = !!hz_relative
  const useDiff = !!hz_difference
  const tableData = rows.map((r) => ({
    "Hazard": r.hazard,
    "Left (abs)": Number(r?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Right (abs)": Number(r?.total2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (abs)": Number(r?.total_diff ?? (Number(r?.total2 ?? 0) - Number(r?.total1 ?? 0))),
    "Left (%)": Number(r?.perc1 ?? 0),
    "Right (%)": Number(r?.perc2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (pp)": Number(r?.pct_diff ?? 0)
  }))

  const columns = useDiff
    ? ["Hazard", usePct ? "Δ (pp)" : "Δ (abs)"]
    : ["Hazard", usePct ? "Left (%)" : "Left (abs)", usePct ? "Right (%)" : "Right (abs)"]

  return {
    filename: "exposure_breakdown_by_hazard",
    data: tableData.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(columns.map((col) => [col, row[col]])))
  }
}

hz_safeEnhancedMultiSelect = (options, cfg = {}) => {
  const label = cfg.label ?? "Select"
  const placeholder = cfg.placeholder ?? "Search…"
  const disabled = !!cfg.disabled

  // Normalize selected values to plain strings
  const value = (Array.isArray(cfg.value) ? cfg.value : [])
    .map(v => (v && typeof v === "object") ? (v.value ?? v.name ?? v.label ?? v.id ?? v) : v)
    .map(v => String(v ?? "").trim())
    .filter(Boolean)

  // Normalize options into {value,label} with *string* values.
  const rows = (options ?? [])
    .map((o) => {
      if (o == null) return null
      if (typeof o === "string" || typeof o === "number") {
        const v = String(o).trim()
        if (!v) return null
        const lbl = (typeof cfg.format === "function") ? String(cfg.format(v)) : v
        return { value: v, label: lbl }
      }
      if (typeof o === "object") {
        const v = String(o.value ?? o.id ?? o.key ?? o.name ?? "").trim()
        if (!v) return null
        const lbl = String(o.label ?? o.name ?? o.value ?? v)
        return { value: v, label: lbl }
      }
      return null
    })
    .filter(Boolean)

  const map = new Map(rows.map(r => [r.value, r.label]))
  const values = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(r => r.value)))

  const format = (v) => map.get(String(v)) ?? String(v)

  const viewofSelect = Inputs.select(values, {
    label,
    multiple: true,
    value,
    disabled,
    format
  })

  return enhancedMultiSelect(viewofSelect, {
    placeholder,
    requireAtLeastOne: false,
    maxHeight: cfg.maxHeight ?? 200,
    width: cfg.width ?? "100%"
  })
}

hz_makeBoundSelect = (masterView, options, cfg = {}) => {
  const mirror = Inputs.select(options ?? [], cfg)
  let syncing = false

  const syncFromMaster = () => {
    if (syncing) return
    syncing = true
    try {
      const next = masterView?.value
      if (mirror?.value !== next) {
        try { mirror.value = next } catch (_) {}
      }
    } finally {
      syncing = false
    }
  }

  const syncToMaster = () => {
    if (syncing) return
    syncing = true
    try {
      const next = mirror?.value
      if (masterView?.value !== next) {
        try { masterView.value = next } catch (_) {}
        try { masterView.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })) } catch (_) {}
        try { masterView.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })) } catch (_) {}
      }
    } finally {
      syncing = false
    }
  }

  try { mirror.addEventListener("input", syncToMaster) } catch (_) {}
  try { mirror.addEventListener("change", syncToMaster) } catch (_) {}
  try { masterView?.addEventListener?.("input", syncFromMaster) } catch (_) {}
  try { masterView?.addEventListener?.("change", syncFromMaster) } catch (_) {}

  syncFromMaster()
  return hz_noJumpRoot(mirror)
}

hz_mountNodeOnce = (host, node) => {
  if (!host.__hz_mounted_once) {
    try { host.replaceChildren(node) } catch (_) {
      try { host.innerHTML = "" } catch (_) {}
      try { host.append(node) } catch (_) {}
    }
    host.__hz_mounted_once = true
    host.__hz_mounted_node = node
  } else if (host.__hz_mounted_node !== node && !host.contains(node)) {
    try { host.replaceChildren(node) } catch (_) {}
    host.__hz_mounted_node = node
  }
  return null
}
```
