hz_makeStableMirrorMulti = (masterView, {
  label = "Select",
  format = (d) => String(d ?? ""),
  keyOf = (d) => String(d ?? ""),
  maxSelections = null,
  requireAtLeastOne = false,
  enableFullCountryToggle = false,
  fullCountryPrefix = "Full Country",
  placeholder = "Search…",
  width = "100%",
  maxHeight = 200
} = {}) => {
  const root = html`<div class="hz-stableMirror"></div>`
  let optionsState = []
  let inputNode = null
  let selectEl = null
  let suppressUp = false
  let lastOptionsSig = ""
  let lastValueSig = ""
  let lastDisabled = null

  const normArr = (xs) => Array.isArray(xs) ? xs : (xs == null ? [] : [xs])
  const keyStr = (d) => String(keyOf(d) ?? "").trim()
  const keysFrom = (xs) => new Set(normArr(xs).map(keyStr).filter(Boolean))
  const optionsSigOf = (opts) => JSON.stringify((opts ?? []).map((d) => keyStr(d)))
  const valueSigOf = (xs) => JSON.stringify(Array.from(keysFrom(xs)).sort())

  const getValue = () => {
    if (!selectEl) return []
    const out = []
    Array.from(selectEl.options).forEach((opt, i) => {
      if (opt.selected && optionsState[i] != null) out.push(optionsState[i])
    })
    return out
  }

  const applyValue = (xs) => {
    if (!selectEl) return
    const keys = keysFrom(xs)
    suppressUp = true
    Array.from(selectEl.options).forEach((opt, i) => {
      opt.selected = keys.has(keyStr(optionsState[i]))
    })
    try { selectEl.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })) } catch (_) {}
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { suppressUp = false })
    lastValueSig = valueSigOf(xs)
  }

  const render = (disabled = false) => {
    const rows = (optionsState ?? []).map((d) => ({
      value: keyStr(d),
      label: String(format(d))
    }))
    const view = Inputs.select(rows.map((r) => r.value), {
      label,
      multiple: true,
      value: Array.from(keysFrom(masterView?.value)),
      disabled: !!disabled,
      format: (v) => rows.find((r) => r.value === String(v))?.label ?? String(v)
    })
    enhancedMultiSelect(view, {
      maxSelections,
      requireAtLeastOne,
      enableFullCountryToggle,
      fullCountryPrefix,
      placeholder,
      width,
      maxHeight
    })
    const select = view.querySelector?.("select") || view
    select.addEventListener("input", () => {
      if (suppressUp) return
      const next = getValue()
      try { masterView.value = next } catch (_) {}
      try { masterView.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })) } catch (_) {}
      try { root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })) } catch (_) {}
      lastValueSig = valueSigOf(next)
    })
    try { root.replaceChildren(view) } catch (_) {
      try { root.innerHTML = "" } catch (_) {}
      try { root.append(view) } catch (_) {}
    }
    inputNode = view
    selectEl = select
    lastDisabled = !!disabled
    applyValue(masterView?.value)
  }

  root.sync = (opts, xs = masterView?.value, { disabled = false } = {}) => {
    const optSig = optionsSigOf(opts)
    const valSig = valueSigOf(xs)
    optionsState = Array.isArray(opts) ? opts : []
    const needRender = !inputNode || optSig != lastOptionsSig || !!disabled !== lastDisabled
    lastOptionsSig = optSig
    if (needRender) {
      render(disabled)
    } else if (valSig != lastValueSig) {
      applyValue(xs)
    }
  }

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get() { return getValue() },
    set(v) { applyValue(v) }
  })

  return root
}

hz_makeFiltersPanel = ({ hintNode, rows, open = false, onToggle = null } = {}) => {
  const el = html`
    <details class="hz-furl hz-furl--filters">
      <summary><span>Filters</span></summary>
      <div class="hz-furl__body">
        <div class="hz-controlsCompact hz-controlsPanel">
          <div class="hz-controlsRows"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </details>
  `
  try { el.querySelector("summary").append(hintNode) } catch (_) {}
  const rowsWrap = el.querySelector(".hz-controlsRows")
  ;(rows ?? []).forEach((r) => { try { rowsWrap.append(r) } catch (_) {} })
  el.open = !!open
  if (typeof onToggle === "function") el.addEventListener("toggle", () => onToggle(el.open))
  return hz_holdViewportOnAsyncInput(el)
}

hz_q3_chartHost = html`<div class="hz-chartWrap hz-chartHost"><div class="hz-loading">Loading chart…</div></div>`
hz_q3_tableHost = html`<div class="hz-tableWrap hz-tableHost"><div class="hz-loading">Loading table…</div></div>`

// Q3 busy overlay controller
hz_q3_ui = {
  const ui = (globalThis.__ATLAS_HZ_UI_Q3__ ??= {})
  ui.chartWrap = hz_q3_chartHost
  ui.tableWrap = hz_q3_tableHost
  ui._busyCount = ui._busyCount ?? 0
  ui.setBusy = (on) => {
    ui._busyCount = Math.max(0, ui._busyCount + (on ? 1 : -1))
    const busy = ui._busyCount > 0
    try { ui.chartWrap?.classList.toggle("hz-chartWrap--busy", busy) } catch (_) {}
    try { ui.tableWrap?.classList.toggle("hz-tableWrap--busy", busy) } catch (_) {}
  }
  return null
}

</div>`;

</div>`;

  const mode = (hz_q3_viewMode || "chart")
  try { hz_q3_chartCard.style.display = (mode === "chart") ? "" : "none" } catch (_) {}
  try { hz_q3_tableCard.style.display = (mode === "table") ? "" : "none" } catch (_) {}
  try { hz_q3_settingsWrap.style.visibility = "visible" } catch (_) {}

}

  <div class="hz-qToolbar__right hz-qToolbar__right--grow">
    <div class="hz-q2SettingsGrid">
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q3-label-showpct">Show %</span>${viewof hz_q3_relative}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q3-label-showcompound">Show compound hazards</span>${viewof hz_q3_showCompound}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q3-label-simplifycompound">Simplify compound hazards</span>${viewof hz_q3_simplifyCompound}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q3-label-includenohazard">Include no hazard</span>${viewof hz_q3_includeNoHazard}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q3-label-freex">Free X axis</span>${viewof hz_q3_freeX}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--range"><span id="hz-q3-label-topn">Number of commodities</span>${viewof hz_q3_topN}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--range"><span id="hz-q3-label-height">Height</span>${viewof hz_q3_chartHeight}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
`

// Reuse the single shared Q2 response
hz_q3Resp = hz_q2Resp

hz_q3RowsL = hz_q3Resp.left ?? []
hz_q3RowsR = hz_q3Resp.right ?? []
hz_q3DenomByCrop = hz_q3Resp.denom_by_crop ?? []
hz_q3DenomTotal = (hz_q3DenomByCrop ?? []).reduce((s, d) => s + (Number(d?.value_tot) || 0), 0)

hz_q3TableView = {
  if (!hz_q3Resp?.ok) return html`<div class="hz-muted">No data.</div>`

  const num = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0
  }
  const clampPct = (x) => Math.max(-100, Math.min(100, x))

  const leftRows = Array.isArray(hz_q3RowsL) ? hz_q3RowsL : []
  const rightRows = Array.isArray(hz_q3RowsR) ? hz_q3RowsR : []
  const denomByCrop = Array.isArray(hz_q3DenomByCrop) ? hz_q3DenomByCrop : []
  const denomMap = new Map(denomByCrop.map(d => [d?.crop, num(d?.value_tot)]))
  const denomTotal = num(hz_q3DenomTotal) || Array.from(denomMap.values()).reduce((a,b) => a + b, 0)

  const anyMap = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (String(r?.hazard ?? "") !== "any") continue
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      m.set(crop, num(r?.total))
    }
    return m
  }
  const anyL = anyMap(leftRows)
  const anyR = anyMap(rightRows)

  const withNoHazard = (rows, any) => {
    const out = rows.slice()
    const crops = new Set([...Array.from(denomMap.keys()), ...rows.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean)])
    for (const crop of crops) {
      const tot = num(denomMap.get(crop))
      const exposed = num(any.get(crop))
      out.push({ hazard: "no hazard", crop, total: Math.max(0, tot - exposed) })
    }
    return out
  }
  const L0 = withNoHazard(leftRows, anyL)
  const R0 = withNoHazard(rightRows, anyR)

  const toExclusive = (rows) => {
    const out = []
    for (const r of rows) {
      const h0 = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const v = num(r?.total)
      if (h0 === "any") continue
      if (h0 === "dry") out.push({ hazard: "dry (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "heat") out.push({ hazard: "heat (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "wet") out.push({ hazard: "wet (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "no hazard") out.push({ hazard: "no hazard", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "dry+heat" || h0 === "dry+wet" || h0 === "heat+wet" || h0 === "dry+heat+wet") out.push({ hazard: h0, crop, total: v })
    }
    return out
  }

  const simplifyExclusive = (rows) => {
    const bucket = (h) => {
      if (h === "no hazard") return "no hazard"
      const core = String(h ?? "").replace(" (only)", "")
      const n = core.split("+").filter(Boolean).length
      if (n === 1) return "1 hazard"
      if (n === 2) return "2 hazards"
      if (n === 3) return "3 hazards"
      return null
    }
    const agg = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const b = bucket(String(r?.hazard ?? ""))
      if (!b) continue
      const key = `${crop}||${b}`
      agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + num(r?.total))
    }
    const out = []
    for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
      const [crop, hazard] = key.split("||")
      out.push({ crop, hazard, total })
    }
    return out
  }

  const toOverlapping = (rows) => {
    const agg = new Map()
    const add = (crop, haz, v) => {
      const key = `${crop}||${haz}`
      agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + v)
    }
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      const v = num(r?.total)
      if (!h) continue
      if (h === "no hazard") { add(crop, "no hazard", v); continue }
      if (h === "any") continue
      if (h.includes("dry")) add(crop, "dry (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("heat")) add(crop, "heat (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("wet")) add(crop, "wet (any)", v)
    }
    const out = []
    for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
      const [crop, hazard] = key.split("||")
      out.push({ crop, hazard, total })
    }
    return out
  }

  const showCompound = !!hz_q3_showCompound
  const simplify = !!hz_q3_simplifyCompound
  const showNoHaz = !!hz_q3_includeNoHazard

  const L = showCompound ? toExclusive(L0) : toOverlapping(L0)
  const R = showCompound ? toExclusive(R0) : toOverlapping(R0)

  const Lb = (showCompound && simplify) ? simplifyExclusive(L) : L
  const Rb = (showCompound && simplify) ? simplifyExclusive(R) : R

  const hazardCore = showCompound
    ? (simplify
        ? ["1 hazard", "2 hazards", "3 hazards"]
        : ["dry (only)", "heat (only)", "wet (only)", "dry+heat", "dry+wet", "heat+wet", "dry+heat+wet"])
    : ["dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"]

  const hazardDomain = showNoHaz ? hazardCore.concat(["no hazard"]) : hazardCore.slice()

  const key = (crop, hazard) => `${crop}||${hazard}`
  const mapSide = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      const haz = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      if (!crop || !haz) continue
      if (!hazardDomain.includes(haz)) continue
      m.set(key(crop, haz), num(r?.total))
    }
    return m
  }
  const mL = mapSide(Lb)
  const mR = mapSide(Rb)

  const cropsAll = new Set([
    ...Array.from(denomMap.keys()),
    ...Lb.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean),
    ...Rb.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean)
  ])

  const score = (crop) => num(anyL.get(crop)) + num(anyR.get(crop))
  const topCropsSource = Array.from(cropsAll).sort((a,b) => score(b) - score(a))
  const topN = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.max(1, topCropsSource.length || 1), Number(hz_q3_topN) || topCropsSource.length || 1))
  const topCrops = topCropsSource.slice(0, topN)
  const topSet = new Set(topCrops)

  const otherTotals = new Map()
  for (const haz of hazardDomain) {
    for (const crop of cropsAll) {
      if (topSet.has(crop)) continue
      const k = key(crop, haz)
      const prev = otherTotals.get(haz) || { left: 0, right: 0 }
      prev.left += num(mL.get(k))
      prev.right += num(mR.get(k))
      otherTotals.set(haz, prev)
    }
  }

  const cropDomain = topCrops.concat(["Other"])
  const cropOrder = new Map(cropDomain.map((crop, i) => [crop, i]))
  const hazOrder = new Map(hazardDomain.map((haz, i) => [haz, i]))
  const showPct = !!hz_q3_relative

  const tableData = []
  for (const haz of hazardDomain) {
    for (const crop of cropDomain) {
      let left = 0
      let right = 0
      if (crop === "Other") {
        const tot = otherTotals.get(haz) || { left: 0, right: 0 }
        left = tot.left
        right = tot.right
      } else {
        left = num(mL.get(key(crop, haz)))
        right = num(mR.get(key(crop, haz)))
      }
      if (left === 0 && right === 0) continue
      const diff = right - left
      const leftPct = clampPct(denomTotal ? (100 * left / denomTotal) : 0)
      const rightPct = clampPct(denomTotal ? (100 * right / denomTotal) : 0)
      const diffPct = rightPct - leftPct
      tableData.push({
        "Hazard": haz,
        "Crop": crop,
        "Left (abs)": left,
        "Right (abs)": right,
        "Δ (abs)": diff,
        "Left (%)": leftPct,
        "Right (%)": rightPct,
        "Δ (pp)": diffPct
      })
    }
  }

  tableData.sort((a, b) => {
    const hazCmp = (hazOrder.get(a?.["Hazard"]) ?? 9999) - (hazOrder.get(b?.["Hazard"]) ?? 9999)
    if (hazCmp !== 0) return hazCmp
    return (cropOrder.get(a?.["Crop"]) ?? 9999) - (cropOrder.get(b?.["Crop"]) ?? 9999)
  })

  if (!tableData.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">No data.</div>`

  const fmtAbs = (v) => hz_formatNumber(Number(v ?? 0), { digits: 2, compact: false })
  const fmtPct = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    return `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })}%`
  }
  const fmtPP = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })} pp`
  }
  const fmtSignedAbs = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })}`
  }

  const columns = showPct
    ? ["Hazard", "Crop", "Left (%)", "Right (%)", "Δ (pp)"]
    : ["Hazard", "Crop", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)", "Δ (abs)"]

  return hz_atlasTable(tableData, {
    columns,
    format: {
      "Left (abs)": fmtAbs,
      "Right (abs)": fmtAbs,
      "Δ (abs)": fmtSignedAbs,
      "Left (%)": fmtPct,
      "Right (%)": fmtPct,
      "Δ (pp)": fmtPP
    },
    rows: tableData.length,
    height: null,
    width: {
      "Hazard": 180,
      "Crop": 220,
      "Left (abs)": 140,
      "Right (abs)": 140,
      "Δ (abs)": 140,
      "Left (%)": 120,
      "Right (%)": 120,
      "Δ (pp)": 120
    }
  })
}

hz_q3SummaryExport = {
  if (!hz_q3Resp?.ok) return { filename: "greatest_hazards_to_commodities", data: [] }

  const num = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0
  }
  const clampPct = (x) => Math.max(-100, Math.min(100, x))

  const leftRows = Array.isArray(hz_q3RowsL) ? hz_q3RowsL : []
  const rightRows = Array.isArray(hz_q3RowsR) ? hz_q3RowsR : []
  const denomByCrop = Array.isArray(hz_q3DenomByCrop) ? hz_q3DenomByCrop : []
  const denomMap = new Map(denomByCrop.map(d => [d?.crop, num(d?.value_tot)]))
  const denomTotal = num(hz_q3DenomTotal) || Array.from(denomMap.values()).reduce((a,b) => a + b, 0)

  const anyMap = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (String(r?.hazard ?? "") !== "any") continue
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      m.set(crop, num(r?.total))
    }
    return m
  }
  const anyL = anyMap(leftRows)
  const anyR = anyMap(rightRows)

  const withNoHazard = (rows, any) => {
    const out = rows.slice()
    const crops = new Set([...Array.from(denomMap.keys()), ...rows.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean)])
    for (const crop of crops) {
      const tot = num(denomMap.get(crop))
      const exposed = num(any.get(crop))
      out.push({ hazard: "no hazard", crop, total: Math.max(0, tot - exposed) })
    }
    return out
  }
  const L0 = withNoHazard(leftRows, anyL)
  const R0 = withNoHazard(rightRows, anyR)

  const toExclusive = (rows) => {
    const out = []
    for (const r of rows) {
      const h0 = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const v = num(r?.total)
      if (h0 === "any") continue
      if (h0 === "dry") out.push({ hazard: "dry (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "heat") out.push({ hazard: "heat (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "wet") out.push({ hazard: "wet (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "no hazard") out.push({ hazard: "no hazard", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "dry+heat" || h0 === "dry+wet" || h0 === "heat+wet" || h0 === "dry+heat+wet") out.push({ hazard: h0, crop, total: v })
    }
    return out
  }

  const simplifyExclusive = (rows) => {
    const bucket = (h) => {
      if (h === "no hazard") return "no hazard"
      const core = String(h ?? "").replace(" (only)", "")
      const n = core.split("+").filter(Boolean).length
      if (n === 1) return "1 hazard"
      if (n === 2) return "2 hazards"
      if (n === 3) return "3 hazards"
      return null
    }
    const agg = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const b = bucket(String(r?.hazard ?? ""))
      if (!b) continue
      const key = `${crop}||${b}`
      agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + num(r?.total))
    }
    const out = []
    for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
      const [crop, hazard] = key.split("||")
      out.push({ crop, hazard, total })
    }
    return out
  }

  const toOverlapping = (rows) => {
    const agg = new Map()
    const add = (crop, haz, v) => {
      const key = `${crop}||${haz}`
      agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + v)
    }
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      const v = num(r?.total)
      if (!h) continue
      if (h === "no hazard") { add(crop, "no hazard", v); continue }
      if (h === "any") continue
      if (h.includes("dry")) add(crop, "dry (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("heat")) add(crop, "heat (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("wet")) add(crop, "wet (any)", v)
    }
    const out = []
    for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
      const [crop, hazard] = key.split("||")
      out.push({ crop, hazard, total })
    }
    return out
  }

  const showCompound = !!hz_q3_showCompound
  const simplify = !!hz_q3_simplifyCompound
  const showNoHaz = !!hz_q3_includeNoHazard

  const L = showCompound ? toExclusive(L0) : toOverlapping(L0)
  const R = showCompound ? toExclusive(R0) : toOverlapping(R0)

  const Lb = (showCompound && simplify) ? simplifyExclusive(L) : L
  const Rb = (showCompound && simplify) ? simplifyExclusive(R) : R

  const hazardCore = showCompound
    ? (simplify
        ? ["1 hazard", "2 hazards", "3 hazards"]
        : ["dry (only)", "heat (only)", "wet (only)", "dry+heat", "dry+wet", "heat+wet", "dry+heat+wet"])
    : ["dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"]

  const hazardDomain = showNoHaz ? hazardCore.concat(["no hazard"]) : hazardCore.slice()

  const key = (crop, hazard) => `${crop}||${hazard}`
  const mapSide = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      const haz = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      if (!crop || !haz) continue
      if (!hazardDomain.includes(haz)) continue
      m.set(key(crop, haz), num(r?.total))
    }
    return m
  }
  const mL = mapSide(Lb)
  const mR = mapSide(Rb)

  const cropsAll = new Set([
    ...Array.from(denomMap.keys()),
    ...Lb.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean),
    ...Rb.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean)
  ])

  const score = (crop) => num(anyL.get(crop)) + num(anyR.get(crop))
  const topCropsSource = Array.from(cropsAll).sort((a,b) => score(b) - score(a))
  const topN = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.max(1, topCropsSource.length || 1), Number(hz_q3_topN) || topCropsSource.length || 1))
  const topCrops = topCropsSource.slice(0, topN)
  const topSet = new Set(topCrops)

  const otherTotals = new Map()
  for (const haz of hazardDomain) {
    for (const crop of cropsAll) {
      if (topSet.has(crop)) continue
      const k = key(crop, haz)
      const prev = otherTotals.get(haz) || { left: 0, right: 0 }
      prev.left += num(mL.get(k))
      prev.right += num(mR.get(k))
      otherTotals.set(haz, prev)
    }
  }

  const cropDomain = topCrops.concat(["Other"])
  const cropOrder = new Map(cropDomain.map((crop, i) => [crop, i]))
  const hazOrder = new Map(hazardDomain.map((haz, i) => [haz, i]))
  const showPct = !!hz_q3_relative

  const tableData = []
  for (const haz of hazardDomain) {
    for (const crop of cropDomain) {
      let left = 0
      let right = 0
      if (crop === "Other") {
        const tot = otherTotals.get(haz) || { left: 0, right: 0 }
        left = tot.left
        right = tot.right
      } else {
        left = num(mL.get(key(crop, haz)))
        right = num(mR.get(key(crop, haz)))
      }
      if (left === 0 && right === 0) continue
      const diff = right - left
      const leftPct = clampPct(denomTotal ? (100 * left / denomTotal) : 0)
      const rightPct = clampPct(denomTotal ? (100 * right / denomTotal) : 0)
      const diffPct = rightPct - leftPct
      tableData.push({
        "Hazard": haz,
        "Crop": crop,
        "Left (abs)": left,
        "Right (abs)": right,
        "Δ (abs)": diff,
        "Left (%)": leftPct,
        "Right (%)": rightPct,
        "Δ (pp)": diffPct
      })
    }
  }

  tableData.sort((a, b) => {
    const hazCmp = (hazOrder.get(a?.["Hazard"]) ?? 9999) - (hazOrder.get(b?.["Hazard"]) ?? 9999)
    if (hazCmp !== 0) return hazCmp
    return (cropOrder.get(a?.["Crop"]) ?? 9999) - (cropOrder.get(b?.["Crop"]) ?? 9999)
  })

  const columns = showPct
    ? ["Hazard", "Crop", "Left (%)", "Right (%)", "Δ (pp)"]
    : ["Hazard", "Crop", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)", "Δ (abs)"]

  return {
    filename: "greatest_hazards_to_commodities",
    data: tableData.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(columns.map((col) => [col, row[col]])))
  }
}

hz_q3Charts = {
  const _langTick = masterLanguage
  if (!hz_q3Resp?.ok) {
    return html`<div class="hz-loading"><strong>Unable to load Q3.</strong> ${hz_q3Resp?.error ?? "Unknown error"}</div>`
  }

  const num = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0
  }
  const clampPct = (x) => Math.max(-100, Math.min(100, x))
  const prettyHaz = (h) => {
    const s = String(h ?? "")
    if (!s) return "—"
    return s
      .replace(" (any)", "")
      .replace(" (only)", " only")
      .split("+")
      .map((part) => hz_hazardLabel(part.trim()))
      .join(" + ")
  }

  const leftRows = Array.isArray(hz_q3RowsL) ? hz_q3RowsL : []
  const rightRows = Array.isArray(hz_q3RowsR) ? hz_q3RowsR : []
  const denomByCrop = Array.isArray(hz_q3DenomByCrop) ? hz_q3DenomByCrop : []
  const denomMap = new Map(denomByCrop.map(d => [d?.crop, num(d?.value_tot)]))
  const denomTotal = num(hz_q3DenomTotal) || Array.from(denomMap.values()).reduce((a,b) => a + b, 0)

  // Helper maps: crop -> any exposure
  const anyMap = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      if (String(r?.hazard ?? "") !== "any") continue
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      m.set(crop, num(r?.total))
    }
    return m
  }
  const anyL = anyMap(leftRows)
  const anyR = anyMap(rightRows)

  // Add "no hazard" (per crop): total production - any hazard exposure
  const withNoHazard = (rows, any) => {
    const out = rows.slice()
    const crops = new Set([...Array.from(denomMap.keys()), ...rows.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean)])
    for (const crop of crops) {
      const tot = num(denomMap.get(crop))
      const exposed = num(any.get(crop))
      out.push({ hazard: "no hazard", crop, total: Math.max(0, tot - exposed) })
    }
    return out
  }
  const L0 = withNoHazard(leftRows, anyL)
  const R0 = withNoHazard(rightRows, anyR)

  const toExclusive = (rows) => {
    const out = []
    for (const r of rows) {
      const h0 = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const v = num(r?.total)
      if (h0 === "any") continue
      if (h0 === "dry") out.push({ hazard: "dry (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "heat") out.push({ hazard: "heat (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "wet") out.push({ hazard: "wet (only)", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "no hazard") out.push({ hazard: "no hazard", crop, total: v })
      else if (h0 === "dry+heat" || h0 === "dry+wet" || h0 === "heat+wet" || h0 === "dry+heat+wet") out.push({ hazard: h0, crop, total: v })
    }
    return out
  }

  const simplifyExclusive = (rows) => {
    const bucket = (h) => {
      if (h === "no hazard") return "no hazard"
      const core = String(h ?? "").replace(" (only)", "")
      const n = core.split("+").filter(Boolean).length
      if (n === 1) return "1 hazard"
      if (n === 2) return "2 hazards"
      if (n === 3) return "3 hazards"
      return null
    }
    const agg = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const b = bucket(String(r?.hazard ?? ""))
      if (!b) continue
      const key = `${crop}||${b}`
      agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + num(r?.total))
    }
    const out = []
    for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
      const [crop, hazard] = key.split("||")
      out.push({ crop, hazard, total })
    }
    return out
  }

  // Overlapping hazard buckets (any): dry/heat/wet based on intersections (excluding "any"/"no hazard")
  const toOverlapping = (rows) => {
    const agg = new Map()
    const add = (crop, haz, v) => {
      const key = `${crop}||${haz}`
      agg.set(key, (agg.get(key) || 0) + v)
    }
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      if (!crop) continue
      const h = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      const v = num(r?.total)
      if (!h) continue
      if (h === "no hazard") { add(crop, "no hazard", v); continue }
      if (h === "any") continue
      if (h.includes("dry")) add(crop, "dry (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("heat")) add(crop, "heat (any)", v)
      if (h.includes("wet")) add(crop, "wet (any)", v)
    }
    const out = []
    for (const [key, total] of agg.entries()) {
      const [crop, hazard] = key.split("||")
      out.push({ crop, hazard, total })
    }
    return out
  }

  const showCompound = !!hz_q3_showCompound
  const simplify = !!hz_q3_simplifyCompound
  const showNoHaz = !!hz_q3_includeNoHazard
  const includeDecreases = false

  const L = showCompound ? toExclusive(L0) : toOverlapping(L0)
  const R = showCompound ? toExclusive(R0) : toOverlapping(R0)

  const Lb = (showCompound && simplify) ? simplifyExclusive(L) : L
  const Rb = (showCompound && simplify) ? simplifyExclusive(R) : R

  const hazardCore = showCompound
    ? (simplify
        ? ["1 hazard", "2 hazards", "3 hazards"]
        : ["dry (only)", "heat (only)", "wet (only)", "dry+heat", "dry+wet", "heat+wet", "dry+heat+wet"])
    : ["dry (any)", "heat (any)", "wet (any)"]

  const hazardDomain = showNoHaz ? hazardCore.concat(["no hazard"]) : hazardCore.slice()

  // Merge left/right by crop×hazard
  const key = (crop, hazard) => `${crop}||${hazard}`
  const mapSide = (rows) => {
    const m = new Map()
    for (const r of rows) {
      const crop = r?.crop
      const haz = String(r?.hazard ?? "")
      if (!crop || !haz) continue
      if (!hazardDomain.includes(haz)) continue
      m.set(key(crop, haz), num(r?.total))
    }
    return m
  }
  const mL = mapSide(Lb)
  const mR = mapSide(Rb)

  const cropsAll = new Set([
    ...Array.from(denomMap.keys()),
    ...Lb.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean),
    ...Rb.map(r => r?.crop).filter(Boolean)
  ])

  // Top-N crops by combined ANY exposure
  const score = (crop) => num(anyL.get(crop)) + num(anyR.get(crop))
  const topCropsSource = Array.from(cropsAll).sort((a,b) => score(b) - score(a))
  const topN = Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.max(1, topCropsSource.length || 1), Number(hz_q3_topN) || topCropsSource.length || 1))
  const topCrops = topCropsSource.slice(0, topN)

  const cropDomain = topCrops.concat(["Other"])
  const topSet = new Set(topCrops)

  const toDisplayAbs = (v) => hz_q3_relative ? clampPct(denomTotal ? (100 * v / denomTotal) : 0) : v

  // Build plot records for each hazard panel
  const makePanelData = (haz) => {
    let tot1 = 0, tot2 = 0
    for (const crop of cropsAll) {
      tot1 += num(mL.get(key(crop, haz)))
      tot2 += num(mR.get(key(crop, haz)))
    }

    const rows = []
    let other1 = 0, other2 = 0, otherDPos = 0, otherDNeg = 0

    for (const crop of cropsAll) {
      const v1 = num(mL.get(key(crop, haz)))
      const v2 = num(mR.get(key(crop, haz)))
      const d = v2 - v1
      const pos = Math.max(0, d)
      const neg = Math.min(0, d)

      if (topSet.has(crop)) {
        rows.push({
          hazard: haz,
          scenario: "S1",
          crop,
          value: toDisplayAbs(v1),
          pos: toDisplayAbs(v1),
          neg: 0,
          signed: v1
        })
        rows.push({
          hazard: haz,
          scenario: "S2",
          crop,
          value: toDisplayAbs(v2),
          pos: toDisplayAbs(v2),
          neg: 0,
          signed: v2
        })
        rows.push({
          hazard: haz,
          scenario: "Δ",
          crop,
          value: toDisplayAbs(includeDecreases ? d : pos),
          pos: toDisplayAbs(pos),
          neg: includeDecreases ? toDisplayAbs(neg) : 0,
          signed: d
        })
      } else {
        other1 += v1
        other2 += v2
        otherDPos += pos
        otherDNeg += neg
      }
    }

    rows.push({
      hazard: haz,
      scenario: "S1",
      crop: "Other",
      value: toDisplayAbs(other1),
      pos: toDisplayAbs(other1),
      neg: 0,
      signed: other1
    })
    rows.push({
      hazard: haz,
      scenario: "S2",
      crop: "Other",
      value: toDisplayAbs(other2),
      pos: toDisplayAbs(other2),
      neg: 0,
      signed: other2
    })
    rows.push({
      hazard: haz,
      scenario: "Δ",
      crop: "Other",
      value: toDisplayAbs(includeDecreases ? (otherDPos + otherDNeg) : (otherDPos)),
      pos: toDisplayAbs(otherDPos),
      neg: includeDecreases ? toDisplayAbs(otherDNeg) : 0,
      signed: otherDPos + otherDNeg
    })

    return { rows, tot1, tot2, diff: (tot2 - tot1) }
  }

  const panels = hazardDomain.map(h => ({ haz: h, ...makePanelData(h) }))

  const fmtAbs = (x) => hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })
  const fmtPct = (x) => `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })}%`
  const xLabel = hz_q3_relative ? "% of total production value" : (hz_varLabelAbs ?? "Exposure")

  // Dynamic insight
  const hazardTotals = panels
    .filter(p => p.haz !== "no hazard")
    .map(p => ({
      hazard: p.haz,
      total1: p.tot1,
      total2: p.tot2,
      diff: p.diff
    }))

  const topL = hazardTotals.slice().sort((a,b) => b.total1 - a.total1)[0]
  const topR = hazardTotals.slice().sort((a,b) => b.total2 - a.total2)[0]
  const topD = hazardTotals.slice().sort((a,b) => Math.abs(b.diff) - Math.abs(a.diff))[0]

  const pctOfTotal = (v) => denomTotal ? (100 * v / denomTotal) : 0

  const insightVerb = (topD?.diff ?? 0) >= 0
    ? hz_t("sections.q3.insight.increases")
    : hz_t("sections.q3.insight.decreases")

  const insight = md`${[
    `**${hz_t("sections.q3.insight.heading")}**`,
    "",
    hz_tpl("sections.q3.insight.line1", {
      s1: hz_s1.label,
      haz1: prettyHaz(topL?.hazard),
      val1: fmtAbs(topL?.total1 ?? 0),
      unit: hz_varShort ?? "",
      pct1: fmtPct(pctOfTotal(topL?.total1 ?? 0))
    }),
    hz_tpl("sections.q3.insight.line2", {
      s2: hz_s2.label,
      haz2: prettyHaz(topR?.hazard),
      val2: fmtAbs(topR?.total2 ?? 0),
      unit: hz_varShort ?? "",
      pct2: fmtPct(pctOfTotal(topR?.total2 ?? 0))
    }),
    hz_tpl("sections.q3.insight.line3", {
      haz3: prettyHaz(topD?.hazard),
      verb: insightVerb,
      delta: fmtAbs(Math.abs(topD?.diff ?? 0)),
      unit: hz_varShort ?? "",
      pct3: fmtPct(Math.abs(pctOfTotal(topD?.diff ?? 0)))
    })
  ].join("\n\n")}`

  // Panel plotting
  const w = Number(hz_plotWidth) || 920
  const gap = 14
  const minCol = 360
  const cols = Math.max(1, Math.floor((w + gap) / (minCol + gap)))
  const colW = Math.max(minCol, Math.floor((w - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols))
  const hInput = Number(hz_q3_chartHeight) || 520
  const h = Math.max(190, Math.min(320, Math.round(hInput * 0.58)))

  // Compute x-domain from stacked totals
  const scenarios = ["S1", "S2", "Δ"]
  let xMax = 0
  let xMin = 0

  for (const p of panels) {
    const sumsPos = new Map()
    const sumsNeg = new Map()

    for (const r of (p.rows ?? [])) {
      const s = String(r?.scenario ?? "")
      const v = num(r?.value)
      sumsPos.set(s, (sumsPos.get(s) || 0) + Math.max(0, v))
      sumsNeg.set(s, (sumsNeg.get(s) || 0) + Math.min(0, v))
    }

    for (const s of scenarios) {
      xMax = Math.max(xMax, sumsPos.get(s) || 0)
      xMin = Math.min(xMin, sumsNeg.get(s) || 0)
    }
  }

  if (!includeDecreases) xMin = 0

  const xPadMax = xMax > 0 ? xMax * 1.08 : 1
  const xPadMin = xMin < 0 ? xMin * 1.08 : 0
  const xDomain = [xPadMin, xPadMax]

  const legendCols = Math.max(3, Math.min(6, Math.ceil(cropDomain.length / 2)))
  const legend = Plot.legend({ color: { domain: cropDomain, scheme: "tableau10" }, columns: legendCols })
  const freeX = !!hz_q3_freeX

  const panelDomain = (panel) => {
    let pMax = 0
    let pMin = 0
    for (const s of scenarios) {
      let sumPos = 0
      let sumNeg = 0
      for (const r of (panel?.rows ?? [])) {
        if (String(r?.scenario ?? "") !== s) continue
        const v = num(r?.value)
        sumPos += Math.max(0, v)
        sumNeg += Math.min(0, v)
      }
      pMax = Math.max(pMax, sumPos)
      pMin = Math.min(pMin, sumNeg)
    }
    if (!includeDecreases) pMin = 0
    const padMax = pMax > 0 ? pMax * 1.08 : 1
    const padMin = pMin < 0 ? pMin * 1.08 : 0
    return [padMin, padMax]
  }

  const buildPanel = (panel, i) => {
    // Show the x-axis on every hazard panel.
    const showX = true
    const data = panel.rows
    const tipFmt = {
      scenario: true,
      crop: true,
      value: hz_q3_relative ? fmtPct : fmtAbs
    }
    const panelXDomain = freeX ? panelDomain(panel) : xDomain

    const barMark = Plot.barX(data, Plot.stackX({
      y: "scenario",
      x: "value",
      fill: "crop",
      insetTop: 3,
      insetBottom: 3,
      tip: { format: tipFmt }
    }))

    return html`
      <div class="hz-sideCard hz-sideCard--plot">
        <div class="hz-sideCard__body">
          <div class="hz-mini__title">${prettyHaz(panel.haz)}</div>
          ${Plot.plot({
            width: colW,
            height: h,
            style: { overflow: "visible" },
            marginLeft: 72,
            marginRight: 16,
            marginTop: 10,
            marginBottom: showX ? 34 : 18,
            x: { label: showX ? xLabel : null, grid: true, axis: showX ? "bottom" : null, domain: panelXDomain, tickFormat: hz_q3_relative ? fmtPct : fmtAbs },
            y: { domain: ["S1", "S2", "Δ"], label: null },
            color: { domain: cropDomain, scheme: "tableau10", legend: false },
            marks: [
              Plot.ruleX([0]),
              barMark
            ]
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    `
  }

  const subtitle = `${hz_geoLabel} • ${hz_commodityLabel} • Left: ${hz_s1.label} • Right: ${hz_s2.label}`

  return html`
    <div class="hz-legendRow">${legend}</div>
    <div style="display:grid;gap:${gap}px;grid-template-columns:repeat(${cols}, 1fr);">
      ${panels.map((p,i) => buildPanel(p, i))}
    </div>
    <div class="hz-upsetCaption">${subtitle}</div>
    <div class="hz-qInsight">${insight}</div>
    ${hz_renderSummaryDownloadButton(hz_q3SummaryExport, "greatest_hazards_to_commodities")}
  `
}
hz_q3_mountChart = {
  hz_q3_chartHost.replaceChildren(hz_q3Charts)
  return null
}

hz_q3_mountTable = {
  hz_q3_tableHost.replaceChildren(hz_q3TableView)
  return null
}

hz_q3_dashboardCard = hz_noJumpRoot(html`
<div class="hz-card">
  <div class="hz-card__body">
    <div id="hz-q3-overview" class="hz-qOverview"></div>

    ${hz_q3_filtersHost}

    <div class="hz-qToolbar">
      <div class="hz-qToolbar__left">${viewof hz_q3_viewMode}</div>
      ${hz_q3_settingsWrap}
    </div>

    <div class="hz-vizWrap">
      <div class="hz-qResults">
        ${hz_q3_chartCard}
        ${hz_q3_tableCard}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
`);
hz_q4TableView = {
  const detailRows = hz_q4RowsChart ?? []
  const showPct = !!hz_rel

  const fmtAbs = (v) => hz_formatNumber(Number(v ?? 0), { digits: 2, compact: false })
  const fmtPct = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    return `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })}%`
  }
  const fmtPP = (v) => {
    const x = Number(v)
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) return "—"
    const sign = x > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2, compact: false })} pp`
  }

  if (detailRows.length) {
    const tableData = detailRows.map((d) => ({
      "Geography": d.admin,
      "Hazard": d.hazard,
      "Left (abs)": Number(d.total1 ?? 0),
      "Right (abs)": Number(d.total2 ?? 0),
      "Δ (abs)": Number(d.total2 ?? 0) - Number(d.total1 ?? 0),
      "Left (%)": Number(d.value1 ?? 0),
      "Right (%)": Number(d.value2 ?? 0),
      "Δ (pp)": Number(d.delta ?? 0)
    }))

    return html`
      <div>
        <div class="hz-insightSubhead">
          ${hz_q4_showCompound
            ? (hz_q4_simplifyCompound ? "Summary table (compound hazards • simplified)" : "Summary table (compound hazards)")
            : "Summary table (non-compound hazards)"}
        </div>
        ${hz_atlasTable(tableData, {
          columns: showPct
            ? ["Geography", "Hazard", "Left (%)", "Right (%)", "Δ (pp)"]
            : ["Geography", "Hazard", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)", "Δ (abs)"],
          format: {
            "Left (abs)": fmtAbs,
            "Right (abs)": fmtAbs,
            "Δ (abs)": fmtAbs,
            "Left (%)": fmtPct,
            "Right (%)": fmtPct,
            "Δ (pp)": fmtPP
          },
          rows: tableData.length,
          height: null,
          width: {
            "Geography": 200,
            "Hazard": 160,
            "Left (abs)": 130,
            "Right (abs)": 130,
            "Δ (abs)": 120,
            "Left (%)": 120,
            "Right (%)": 120,
            "Δ (pp)": 120
          }
        })}
      </div>
    `
  }

  const rows = (hz_q4Rows ?? []).map((d) => ({
    "Geography": d?.name ?? "Unknown",
    "Left (abs)": Number(d?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Right (abs)": Number(d?.total2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (abs)": Number(d?.total2 ?? 0) - Number(d?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Left (%)": Number(d?.value1 ?? 0),
    "Right (%)": Number(d?.value2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (pp)": Number(d?.delta ?? 0)
  }))

  if (!rows.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">No data.</div>`

  return html`
    <div>
      <div class="hz-insightSubhead">Summary table</div>
      ${hz_atlasTable(rows, {
        columns: showPct
          ? ["Geography", "Left (%)", "Right (%)", "Δ (pp)"]
          : ["Geography", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)", "Δ (abs)"],
        format: {
          "Left (abs)": fmtAbs,
          "Right (abs)": fmtAbs,
          "Δ (abs)": fmtAbs,
          "Left (%)": fmtPct,
          "Right (%)": fmtPct,
          "Δ (pp)": fmtPP
        },
        rows: rows.length,
        height: null,
        width: {
          "Geography": 220,
          "Left (abs)": 140,
          "Right (abs)": 140,
          "Δ (abs)": 130,
          "Left (%)": 120,
          "Right (%)": 120,
          "Δ (pp)": 120
        }
      })}
    </div>
  `
}

hz_q4SummaryExport = {
  const detailRows = hz_q4RowsChart ?? []
  const showPct = !!hz_rel

  if (detailRows.length) {
    const tableData = detailRows.map((d) => ({
      "Geography": d.admin,
      "Hazard": d.hazard,
      "Left (abs)": Number(d.total1 ?? 0),
      "Right (abs)": Number(d.total2 ?? 0),
      "Δ (abs)": Number(d.total2 ?? 0) - Number(d.total1 ?? 0),
      "Left (%)": Number(d.value1 ?? 0),
      "Right (%)": Number(d.value2 ?? 0),
      "Δ (pp)": Number(d.delta ?? 0)
    }))
    const columns = showPct
      ? ["Geography", "Hazard", "Left (%)", "Right (%)", "Δ (pp)"]
      : ["Geography", "Hazard", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)", "Δ (abs)"]
    return {
      filename: "most_exposed_geographies",
      data: tableData.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(columns.map((col) => [col, row[col]])))
    }
  }

  const rows = (hz_q4Rows ?? []).map((d) => ({
    "Geography": d?.name ?? "Unknown",
    "Left (abs)": Number(d?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Right (abs)": Number(d?.total2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (abs)": Number(d?.total2 ?? 0) - Number(d?.total1 ?? 0),
    "Left (%)": Number(d?.value1 ?? 0),
    "Right (%)": Number(d?.value2 ?? 0),
    "Δ (pp)": Number(d?.delta ?? 0)
  }))
  const columns = showPct
    ? ["Geography", "Left (%)", "Right (%)", "Δ (pp)"]
    : ["Geography", "Left (abs)", "Right (abs)", "Δ (abs)"]
  return {
    filename: "most_exposed_geographies",
    data: rows.map((row) => Object.fromEntries(columns.map((col) => [col, row[col]])))
  }
}

hz_q4Insight = {
  const _langTick = masterLanguage
  const num = (x) => (Number.isFinite(Number(x)) ? Number(x) : 0)
  const fmtAbs = (x) => hz_formatNumber(num(x), { digits: 2, compact: false })
  const fmtPct = (x) => `${hz_formatNumber(num(x), { digits: 2, compact: false })}%`
  const fmtDeltaPct = (x) => {
    const v = num(x)
    const sign = v > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })}%`
  }
  const fmtDeltaAbs = (x) => {
    const v = num(x)
    const sign = v > 0 ? "+" : ""
    return `${sign}${hz_formatNumber(v, { digits: 2, compact: false })}`
  }

  const baseL = Array.isArray(hz_q4HazRowsL_norm) ? hz_q4HazRowsL_norm : []
  const baseR = Array.isArray(hz_q4HazRowsR_norm) ? hz_q4HazRowsR_norm : []
  if (!baseL.length && !baseR.length) return html`<div class="hz-muted">${hz_t("sections.q4.insight.empty")}</div>`

  const nonL = hz_q4NonCompoundBuckets(baseL)
  const nonR = hz_q4NonCompoundBuckets(baseR)
  const compExL = hz_q4CompoundExclusive(baseL)
  const compExR = hz_q4CompoundExclusive(baseR)

  const asAdminVal = (rows, predicate) => {
    const out = new Map()
    for (const r of (rows ?? [])) {
      if (!predicate(r)) continue
      const a = String(r?.admin ?? "Unknown")
      out.set(a, (out.get(a) || 0) + num(r?.total))
    }
    return out
  }

  const H_HEAT = hz_t("general.hazards.heat")
  const H_DRY = hz_t("general.hazards.dry")
  const H_WET = hz_t("general.hazards.wet")
  const H_COMPOUND = hz_t("general.hazards.compound")
  const H_ANY = hz_t("general.hazards.anyHazard")

  const hazardSetsL = {
    [H_HEAT]: asAdminVal(nonL, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "heat (any)"),
    [H_DRY]: asAdminVal(nonL, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "dry (any)"),
    [H_WET]: asAdminVal(nonL, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "wet (any)"),
    [H_COMPOUND]: asAdminVal(compExL, (r) => String(r?.hazard || "").includes("+")),
    [H_ANY]: asAdminVal(nonL, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "any")
  }
  const hazardSetsR = {
    [H_HEAT]: asAdminVal(nonR, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "heat (any)"),
    [H_DRY]: asAdminVal(nonR, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "dry (any)"),
    [H_WET]: asAdminVal(nonR, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "wet (any)"),
    [H_COMPOUND]: asAdminVal(compExR, (r) => String(r?.hazard || "").includes("+")),
    [H_ANY]: asAdminVal(nonR, (r) => String(r?.hazard) === "any")
  }

  const totalsL = Array.from(hazardSetsL[H_ANY].values()).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)
  const totalsR = Array.from(hazardSetsR[H_ANY].values()).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)
  const hazardOrder = [H_HEAT, H_DRY, H_WET, H_COMPOUND, H_ANY]

  const topRow = (m) => {
    const rows = Array.from((m ?? new Map()).entries()).map(([admin, value]) => ({ admin, value: num(value) }))
    if (!rows.length) return { admin: "—", value: 0 }
    return rows.reduce((a,b) => (b.value > a.value ? b : a), rows[0])
  }

  const mkScenarioTable = (title, sets, totalAll) => {
    const rows = hazardOrder.map((hz) => {
      const t = topRow(sets[hz] ?? new Map())
      const pct = totalAll > 0 ? 100 * t.value / totalAll : 0
      return {
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.hazard")]: hz,
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.topGeography")]: t.admin,
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.exposure")]: t.value,
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.pctOfTotal")]: pct
      }
    })

    return html`
      <div>
        <div class="hz-insightSubhead">${title}</div>
        ${hz_atlasTable(rows, {
          columns: [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.hazard"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.topGeography"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.exposure"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.pctOfTotal")],
          rows: rows.length,
          height: null,
          format: {
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.exposure")]: fmtAbs,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.pctOfTotal")]: fmtPct
          },
          width: {
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.hazard")]: 120,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.topGeography")]: 240,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.exposure")]: 170,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.pctOfTotal")]: 140
          }
        })}
      </div>
    `
  }

  const mkChangeTable = (title, want) => {
    const rows = hazardOrder.map((hz) => {
      const L = hazardSetsL[hz] ?? new Map()
      const R = hazardSetsR[hz] ?? new Map()
      const admins = Array.from(new Set([...L.keys(), ...R.keys()]))
      const entries = admins.map((admin) => {
        const left = num(L.get(admin))
        const right = num(R.get(admin))
        const delta = right - left
        const pct = left > 0 ? (100 * delta / left) : (right > 0 ? null : 0)
        return { admin, left, right, delta, pct }
      })

      const absCands = entries.filter(e => want === "increase" ? e.delta > 0 : e.delta < 0)
      const pctCands = entries.filter(e => e.pct != null && (want === "increase" ? e.pct > 0 : e.pct < 0))

      const absPick = absCands.length
        ? absCands.reduce((a,b) => want === "increase" ? (b.delta > a.delta ? b : a) : (b.delta < a.delta ? b : a), absCands[0])
        : null
      const pctPick = pctCands.length
        ? pctCands.reduce((a,b) => want === "increase" ? (b.pct > a.pct ? b : a) : (b.pct < a.pct ? b : a), pctCands[0])
        : null

      return {
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.hazard")]: hz,
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.geoAbs")]: absPick?.admin ?? "—",
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaAbs")]: absPick?.delta ?? null,
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.geoPctChange")]: pctPick?.admin ?? "—",
        [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaPctChange")]: pctPick?.pct ?? null
      }
    })

    return html`
      <div>
        <div class="hz-insightSubhead">${title}</div>
        ${hz_atlasTable(rows, {
          columns: [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.hazard"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.geoAbs"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaAbs"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.geoPctChange"), hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaPctChange")],
          rows: rows.length,
          height: null,
          format: {
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaAbs")]: (v) => (v == null ? "—" : fmtDeltaAbs(v)),
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaPctChange")]: (v) => (v == null ? "—" : fmtDeltaPct(v))
          },
          width: {
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.hazard")]: 110,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.geoAbs")]: 220,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaAbs")]: 140,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.geoPctChange")]: 220,
            [hz_t("sections.q4.insight.columns.deltaPctChange")]: 140
          }
        })}
      </div>
    `
  }

  const shownRows = hz_q4Rows ?? []
  const shownL = shownRows.reduce((s, d) => s + num(d?.total1), 0)
  const shownR = shownRows.reduce((s, d) => s + num(d?.total2), 0)
  const displayedTotalL = (hz_q4DataL ?? []).reduce((s, d) => s + num(d?.total), 0)
  const displayedTotalR = (hz_q4DataR ?? []).reduce((s, d) => s + num(d?.total), 0)
  const topShareL = displayedTotalL > 0 ? (100 * shownL / displayedTotalL) : 0
  const topShareR = displayedTotalR > 0 ? (100 * shownR / displayedTotalR) : 0
  const compL = Array.from((hazardSetsL[H_COMPOUND] ?? new Map()).values()).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)
  const compR = Array.from((hazardSetsR[H_COMPOUND] ?? new Map()).values()).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0)
  const compShareL = totalsL > 0 ? (100 * compL / totalsL) : 0
  const compShareR = totalsR > 0 ? (100 * compR / totalsR) : 0

  return html`
    <div class="hz-q4InsightBlock">
      <div class="hz-q4InsightLead">
        ${md`${hz_tpl("sections.q4.insight.lead", {
          topN: Math.max(1, Number(hz_q4_topNEff ?? 10) || 10),
          topShareL: fmtPct(topShareL),
          s1: hz_s1.label,
          topShareR: fmtPct(topShareR),
          s2: hz_s2.label,
          compShareL: fmtPct(compShareL),
          compShareR: fmtPct(compShareR)
        })}`}
      </div>
      <div class="hz-stack" style="display:grid;gap:12px;">
        ${mkScenarioTable(hz_s1.label, hazardSetsL, totalsL)}
        ${mkScenarioTable(hz_s2.label, hazardSetsR, totalsR)}
      </div>
      <div class="hz-stack" style="display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:8px;">
        ${mkChangeTable(hz_t("sections.q4.insight.titles.increase"), "increase")}
        ${mkChangeTable(hz_t("sections.q4.insight.titles.decrease"), "decrease")}
      </div>
      ${hz_renderSummaryDownloadButton(hz_q4SummaryExport, "most_exposed_geographies")}
    </div>
  `
}

// Helper
hz_stripLeadingTitle = (text, title) => {
  const t = String(text ?? "")
  const lines = t.split(/\r?\n/)
  if (lines.length && String(lines[0]).trim() === String(title ?? "").trim()) {
    return lines.slice(1).join("\n").trim()
  }
  return t
}

hz_q4_settingsWrap = html`

    <div class="hz-q2SettingsGrid">
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q4-label-showpct">Show %</span>${viewof hz_rel}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q4-label-showdiff">Show differences</span>${viewof hz_q4_difference}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q4-label-showcompound">Show compound hazards</span>${viewof hz_q4_showCompound}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting"><span id="hz-q4-label-simplifycompound">Simplify compound hazards</span>${viewof hz_q4_simplifyCompound}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--range"><span id="hz-q4-label-topn">No. geographies to show</span>${viewof hz_q4_topN}</div>
      <div class="hz-miniSetting hz-miniSetting--range"><span id="hz-q4-label-height">Height</span>${viewof hz_q4_chartHeight}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
`

hz_q4MapPanel = {
  if (hz_q4Meta?.error) return html`<div class="warn"><b>Q4 query failed:</b><br>${hz_q4Meta.error}</div>`

  const leftRows = Array.isArray(hz_q4DataL) ? hz_q4DataL : []
  const rightRows = Array.isArray(hz_q4DataR) ? hz_q4DataR : []
  if (!leftRows.length && !rightRows.length) return html`<div class="hz-loading">Loading map…</div>`

  const toNum = (x) => {
    const v = Number(x)
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0
  }
  const hz_q4NormName = (s) => String(s ?? "")
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[\u2019']/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
    .trim()

  // Build normalized lookups so minor name formatting differences still join
  const aggNorm = (rows) => {
    const out = new Map()
    for (const d of rows) {
      const rawName = String(d?.admin_name ?? d?.admin ?? d?.name ?? "").trim()
      if (!rawName) continue
      const key = hz_q4NormName(rawName)
      if (!key) continue
      const curr = out.get(key) || { name: rawName, total: 0 }
      curr.total += toNum(d?.total ?? d?.value)
      out.set(key, curr)
    }
    return out
  }
  const mapLNorm = aggNorm(leftRows)
  const mapRNorm = aggNorm(rightRows)
  const apiNormNames = new Set([...mapLNorm.keys(), ...mapRNorm.keys()].filter(Boolean))
  const totalL_all = leftRows.reduce((s, r) => s + toNum(r?.total ?? r?.value), 0)
  const totalR_all = rightRows.reduce((s, r) => s + toNum(r?.total ?? r?.value), 0)
  const mapValueL = (x) => hz_rel ? (totalL_all ? (100 * toNum(x) / totalL_all) : 0) : toNum(x)
  const mapValueR = (x) => hz_rel ? (totalR_all ? (100 * toNum(x) / totalR_all) : 0) : toNum(x)

  const a0 = (hz_geoFilter?.admin0 ?? []).filter(Boolean).filter((x) => String(x).toLowerCase() !== "all")
  const a1 = (hz_geoFilter?.admin1 ?? []).filter(Boolean)
  const a2 = (hz_geoFilter?.admin2 ?? []).filter(Boolean)
  const hz_q4MapLevel = a2.length ? 2 : (a1.length ? 2 : (a0.length ? 1 : 0))
  const hz_q4MapLevelLabel = (hz_q4MapLevel === 2) ? "Admin2" : (hz_q4MapLevel === 1 ? "Admin1" : "Admin0")
  const selectedA2Norms = new Set((a2 ?? []).map(hz_q4NormName).filter(Boolean))

  const boundsObj = await getAdminBoundaries([hz_q4MapLevel])
  const fc = boundsObj?.[`admin${hz_q4MapLevel}`]
  let feats = Array.isArray(fc?.features) ? fc.features.slice() : []
  if (!feats.length) return html`<div class="warn">Boundary features not available for ${hz_q4MapLevelLabel}.</div>`

  const nameKey = hz_guessNameKey(feats[0], hz_q4MapLevel)
  if (!nameKey) return html`<div class="warn">Could not identify the boundary name field for ${hz_q4MapLevelLabel}.</div>`

  const getName = (f) => String(f?.properties?.[nameKey] ?? "").trim()
  const guessKey = (levelWanted) => {
    const props0 = feats?.[0]?.properties ?? {}
    const keys = Object.keys(props0)
    const prefer = (levelWanted === 0)
      ? ["gaul0_name", "admin0_name", "ADM0_NAME", "NAME_0", "country", "COUNTRY", "name", "NAME"]
      : (levelWanted === 1)
        ? ["gaul1_name", "admin1_name", "ADM1_NAME", "NAME_1", "name", "NAME"]
        : ["gaul2_name", "admin2_name", "ADM2_NAME", "NAME_2", "name", "NAME"]
    for (const k of prefer) if (k in props0) return k
    const re = (levelWanted === 0) ? /(gaul0|adm0|admin0|name_0|country)/i
      : (levelWanted === 1) ? /(gaul1|adm1|admin1|name_1)/i
      : /(gaul2|adm2|admin2|name_2)/i
    return keys.find((k) => re.test(k)) || keys.find((k) => /name/i.test(k)) || null
  }
  const admin0Key = guessKey(0)
  const admin1Key = guessKey(1)
  const getAdmin0 = (f) => {
    const p = f?.properties ?? {}
    return (admin0Key && p[admin0Key] != null) ? String(p[admin0Key]).trim() : ""
  }
  const getAdmin1 = (f) => {
    const p = f?.properties ?? {}
    return (admin1Key && p[admin1Key] != null) ? String(p[admin1Key]).trim() : ""
  }

  // Scope to the effective parent geography so zoom and boundary level follow the API request.
  let scoped = feats
  if (hz_q4MapLevel === 1 && a0.length) {
    scoped = feats.filter((f) => a0.includes(getAdmin0(f)))
  }
  if (hz_q4MapLevel === 2) {
    if (a1.length) scoped = feats.filter((f) => a1.includes(getAdmin1(f)))
    else if (a2.length) scoped = feats.filter((f) => selectedA2Norms.has(hz_q4NormName(getName(f))))
  }
  if (!scoped.length) {
    return html`<div class="warn"><b>No matching ${hz_q4MapLevelLabel} boundaries found</b> for the current selection.<br>
      Try clearing the most specific boundary filter and selecting again.</div>`
  }

  const features = scoped
    .filter((f) => f?.geometry && f.geometry.coordinates && f.geometry.coordinates.length)
    .map((f) => {
      const p = f?.properties ?? {}
      const dispName = getName(f)
      const nk = hz_q4NormName(dispName)
      const leftAbs = toNum(mapLNorm.get(nk)?.total)
      const rightAbs = toNum(mapRNorm.get(nk)?.total)
      const left = mapValueL(leftAbs)
      const right = mapValueR(rightAbs)
      return {
        ...f,
        properties: {
          ...p,
          __hz_name: dispName,
          __hz_selected: selectedA2Norms.size ? selectedA2Norms.has(nk) : false,
          __hz_left: left,
          __hz_right: right,
          __hz_delta: right - left
        }
      }
    })

  if (!features.length) {
    return html`<div class="warn"><b>No boundary features found for the current selection.</b></div>`
  }

  const valueMode = hz_mapMetricEff || (hz_q4_difference ? "delta" : "right")
  for (const f of features) {
    const p = f.properties || {}
    const v = (valueMode === "left") ? toNum(p.__hz_left) : ((valueMode === "delta") ? toNum(p.__hz_delta) : toNum(p.__hz_right))
    p.__hz_value = v
  }

  const vals = features.map((f) => toNum(f?.properties?.__hz_value))
  const maxAbs = Math.max(0, ...vals.map((v) => Math.abs(v)))
  const maxPos = Math.max(0, ...vals)

  const height = Math.max(300, Number(hz_q4MapHeight ?? 420) || 420)
  const width = Math.max(520, Number(hz_plotWidth ?? 960) - 10)
  const caption = `${hz_q4MapLevelLabel} • ${hz_geoLabel} • ${hz_commodityLabel} • ${valueMode === "delta" ? "Δ (Right − Left)" : (valueMode === "left" ? `Left: ${hz_s1?.label ?? "Left"}` : `Right: ${hz_s2?.label ?? "Right"}`)}`

  const fillCfg = (valueMode === "delta")
    ? { type: "linear", domain: [-Math.max(maxAbs, 1e-9), Math.max(maxAbs, 1e-9)], range: ["#b91c1c", "#f8fafc", "#0f766e"] }
    : { type: "linear", domain: [0, Math.max(1e-9, maxPos)], range: ["#eff6ff", "#1d4ed8"] }

  const fmtLocal = (x) => hz_rel ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })}%` : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })
  const fmtDelta = (x) => hz_rel ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })} pp` : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })

  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width,
    height,
    margin: 0,
    projection: { type: "mercator", domain: { type: "FeatureCollection", features }, inset: 8 },
    color: {
      ...fillCfg,
      legend: true,
      tickFormat: (x) => hz_rel
        ? `${hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 2 })}%`
        : hz_formatNumber(x, { digits: 1, compact: true }),
      label: (valueMode === "delta")
        ? (hz_rel ? "Difference (pp)" : "Difference")
        : (hz_rel ? "Exposure (%)" : (hz_varLabelAbs ?? hz_varLabel ?? "Exposure"))
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.geo(features, {
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        strokeWidth: 0.8,
        fill: (d) => d?.properties?.__hz_value
      }),
      Plot.geo(features.filter((d) => d?.properties?.__hz_selected), {
        stroke: "#0f172a",
        strokeWidth: 1.8,
        fill: null
      }),
      Plot.geo(features, { stroke: "rgba(15,23,42,.25)", strokeWidth: 0.5, fill: null }),
      Plot.tip(features, Plot.pointer(Plot.centroid({
        title: (d) => {
          const name = d?.properties?.__hz_name ?? "Unknown"
          const left = fmtLocal(d?.properties?.__hz_left)
          const right = fmtLocal(d?.properties?.__hz_right)
          const delta = fmtDelta(d?.properties?.__hz_delta)
          const shown = valueMode === "delta"
            ? `Displayed: ${delta}`
            : `Displayed: ${fmtLocal(d?.properties?.__hz_value)}`
          return [
            `${hz_q4MapLevelLabel || "Geography"}: ${name}`,
            `Left (${hz_s1?.label ?? "Left"}): ${left}`,
            `Right (${hz_s2?.label ?? "Right"}): ${right}`,
            `Δ (Right − Left): ${delta}`,
            shown
          ].join("\n")
        },
        anchor: "top-left",
        textPadding: 6
      })))
    ]
  })

  const joinHits = features.some((f) => apiNormNames.has(hz_q4NormName(f?.properties?.__hz_name)))
  const joinNote = (!joinHits)
    ? html`<div class="hz-muted hz-note">Note: by-admin names did not match boundary names exactly; map is scoped correctly but fill values may be empty.</div>`
    : null

  return html`
    <div class="hz-qToolbar hz-qToolbar--tight">
      <div class="hz-qToolbar__left"></div>
      ${hz_q4_mapSettingsWrap}
    </div>
    <div>
      ${joinNote ? joinNote : html``}
      ${plot}
      ${hz_q4_includeMapCaption ? html`<div class="hz-upsetCaption">${caption}</div>` : html``}
    </div>
  `
}

hz_q4_chartHost = html`<div class="hz-chartWrap hz-chartHost"><div class="hz-loading"><span id="hz-q4-loading-chart">Loading chart…</span></div></div>`

  ui.mapWrap = hz_q4_mapHost
  ui.chartWrap = hz_q4_chartHost
  ui.tableWrap = hz_q4_tableHost
  ui._busyCount = ui._busyCount ?? 0
  ui.setBusy = (on) => {
    ui._busyCount = Math.max(0, ui._busyCount + (on ? 1 : -1))
    const busy = ui._busyCount > 0
    try { ui.mapWrap?.classList.toggle("hz-chartWrap--busy", busy) } catch (_) {}
    try { ui.chartWrap?.classList.toggle("hz-chartWrap--busy", busy) } catch (_) {}
    try { ui.tableWrap?.classList.toggle("hz-tableWrap--busy", busy) } catch (_) {}
  }
  return null
}
